data.title: Hypersensitive detection of single millimeter vascular emboli from adhesive in vivo
data.author: Ruihan Liu, Shuo Li, Xingyu Gao, Quan Zou, Gang Shu, Cai Zhang, Jinbin Pan, Xiaoyuan Chen, Shao-Kai Sun
data.summary: Abstract Surgical adhesives are widely used in clinical practice but pose a significant risk of severe vascular embolism complications. Nevertheless, there are currently no non-invasive direct methods for precise detection of detached emboli. Herein, we show a CT-visualized method for hypersensitive detection of single millimeter vascular emboli from adhesive in vivo by simply doping BiOCl into surgical adhesives. As proof of concept, BiOCl-BioGlue with excellent CT imaging capability is fabricated and applied to repair ruptured vessels and liver in male rats. The location, morphology, and degradation process of BiOCl-BioGlue can be dynamically monitored by CT imaging for 42 days, and pulmonary emboli caused by BiOCl-BioGlue, with sizes as small as 1.2 mm, are successfully detected. Additionally, the high K-edge of Bi enables precise detection of pulmonary emboli in spectral CT imaging, unaffected by confounding calcifications. The proposed non-invasive detection strategy for adhesive emboli significantly enhances the biosafety of surgical adhesives.
data.title_cn: 体内粘合剂单毫米血管栓塞的超灵敏检测
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 手术粘合剂在临床实践中广泛使用，但存在严重血管栓塞并发症的显着风险。然而，目前还没有非侵入性的直接方法来精确检测脱落的栓子。在此，我们展示了一种 CT 可视化方法，通过简单地将 BiOCl 掺杂到手术粘合剂中，可对体内粘合剂中的单毫米血管栓塞进行超灵敏检测。作为概念验证，制造了具有出色 CT 成像能力的 BiOCl-BioGlue，并将其应用于修复雄性大鼠破裂的血管和肝脏。通过CT成像可以动态监测BiOCl-BioGlue的位置、形态和降解过程42天，并成功检测出BiOCl-BioGlue引起的肺栓塞，尺寸小至1.2毫米。此外，Bi 的高 K 边缘能够在能谱 CT 成像中精确检测肺栓塞，而不受混杂钙化的影响。所提出的粘连栓塞非侵入性检测策略显着提高了手术粘连的生物安全性。

data.title: Experimental quantification of hydrogen content in the Earth’s core
data.author: Dongyang Huang, Motohiko Murakami, Stephan Gerstl, Christian Liebske
data.summary: Abstract Earth’s core has long been speculated to be the largest reservoir of hydrogen (H) on the planet. However, current estimates of its H content involve substantial uncertainties, due to the challenge of quantifying H under extreme conditions. Here, we perform superliquidus metal-silicate partitioning experiments on H using laser-heated diamond anvil cells, and combine it with atom probe tomography. The direct observation of H at silicon- and oxygen-rich nanostructures in the iron alloy indicates coupled sequestration of silicon, oxygen and hydrogen into Earth’s core during its formation. With the observed molar Si/H ratio close to unity, Earth’s core is estimated to contain 0.07-0.36 wt.% H, equivalent to 9-45 oceans of water. Such an amount would require the Earth to obtain the majority of its water from the main stages of terrestrial accretion, instead of through comets during late addition.
data.title_cn: 地核氢含量的实验定量
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 长期以来，地核一直被认为是地球上最大的氢 (H) 储库。然而，由于在极端条件下量化 H 的挑战，目前对其 H 含量的估计存在很大的不确定性。在这里，我们使用激光加热金刚石砧池对 H 进行超液相线金属硅酸盐分配实验，并将其与原子探针断层扫描相结合。对铁合金中富含硅和氧的纳米结构中氢的直接观察表明，在地核形成过程中，硅、氧和氢被耦合封存到地核中。由于观测到的 Si/H 摩尔比接近于 1，地球核心估计含有 0.07-0.36 wt.% H，相当于 9-45 个海洋的水。这样的数量将要求地球从陆地吸积的主要阶段获取大部分水，而不是在后期添加过程中通过彗星获取。

data.title: Plasma screening in mid-charged ions observed by K-shell line emission
data.author: M. Šmíd, O. S. Humphries, C. Baehtz, V. Bouffetier, E. Brambrink, T. Burian, V. Cerantola, M. S. Cho, T. E. Cowan, L. Gaus, M. F. Gu, V. Hájková, L. Juha, J. Kaa, Z. Konopkova, M. Kozlová, H. P. Le, M. Makita, X. Pan, T. R. Preston, A. Schropp, J.-P. Schwinkendorf, H. A. Scott, R. Štefaníková, J. Vorberger, W. Wang, U. Zastrau, K. Falk
data.summary: Abstract Dense plasma environment affects the electronic structure of ions via variations of the microscopic electrical fields, also known as plasma screening . This effect can be either estimated by simplified analytical models, or by computationally expensive and to date unverified numerical calculations. We have experimentally quantified plasma screening from the energy shifts of the bound-bound transitions in matter driven by the x-ray free electron laser (XFEL). This was enabled by identification of detailed electronic configurations of the observed K $$\upalpha$$ α , K $$\upbeta$$ β and K $$\upgamma$$ γ lines. This work paves the way for improving plasma screening models including connected effects like ionization potential depression and continuum lowering, which will advance the understanding of atomic physics in the Warm Dense Matter regime.
data.title_cn: 通过 K 壳线发射观察到的中带电离子的等离子体筛选
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 稠密等离子体环境通过微观电场的变化影响离子的电子结构，也称为等离子体屏蔽。这种效应可以通过简化的分析模型来估计，也可以通过计算量大且迄今为止未经验证的数值计算来估计。我们通过 X 射线自由电子激光器 (XFEL) 驱动的物质中束缚跃迁的能量变化，通过实验量化了等离子体筛选。这是通过识别观察到的 K $$\upalpha$$ α 、 K $$\upbeta$$ β 和 K $$\upgamma$$ γ 线的详细电子配置来实现的。这项工作为改进等离子体筛选模型铺平了道路，包括电离势抑制和连续介质降低等相关效应，这将增进对热稠密物质体系中原子物理学的理解。

data.title: Miniaturized flexible skin moisture sensor with optimized coil for enhanced wireless power efficiency
data.author: Jeonghyun Kim, Seongu Kim, Changyu Yeo, Minkyung Kim, Weonho Shin, Jeonghyun Kim
data.summary: Abstract Efficient wireless power transfer is essential for the stable operation of battery-free wearable sensors. Especially for Near Field Communication (NFC)-based sensors, the performance of the antenna coil is a critical factor in determining power reception efficiency and data communication reliability. However, as sensors become smaller, reducing coil size drastically reduces communication sensitivity, making it crucial to design a coil that delivers optimal performance within a limited area. This study focuses on the optimal design of a miniature antenna coil for a wearable sensor capable of measuring skin hydration. Considering the characteristics of wearable devices, the design and experimental validation were conducted to maintain a stable resonant frequency and robust power reception and data communication even under mechanical deformation, such as bending of the skin surface. Consequently, a compact, battery-free sensor platform integrated with the optimized antenna coil enables real-time monitoring of patient skin hydration, and its durability has been proven through rigorous environmental testing. Furthermore, polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) encapsulation ensures mechanical durability and long-term stability. This study highlights the importance of coil optimization in the development of next-generation wearable healthcare devices and provides a basic design framework for miniature sensor systems.
data.title_cn: 微型柔性皮肤湿度传感器，具有优化线圈，可提高无线电源效率
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 高效的无线电力传输对于无电池可穿戴传感器的稳定运行至关重要。特别是对于基于近场通信（NFC）的传感器，天线线圈的性能是决定电力接收效率和数据通信可靠性的关键因素。然而，随着传感器变得越来越小，减小线圈尺寸会大大降低通信灵敏度，因此设计在有限区域内提供最佳性能的线圈至关重要。这项研究的重点是用于能够测量皮肤水合作用的可穿戴传感器的微型天线线圈的优化设计。考虑到可穿戴设备的特点，进行了设计和实验验证，即使在机械变形（例如皮肤表面弯曲）下也能保持稳定的谐振频率和稳健的功率接收和数据通信。因此，紧凑、无电池的传感器平台与优化的天线线圈集成，可以实时监测患者皮肤的水合作用，其耐用性已通过严格的环境测试得到证明。此外，聚二甲基硅氧烷 (PDMS) 封装可确保机械耐用性和长期稳定性。这项研究强调了线圈优化在下一代可穿戴医疗设备开发中的重要性，并为微型传感器系统提供了基本设计框架。

data.title: Development of robust dual functioning PPy-based photothermal membranes for simultaneous freshwater and salt harvesting
data.author: Mahmoud Taha Mahmoud, Hamdy Maamoun Abdel-Ghafar, Ahmed Abdou El-Sherif, Mohamed Saada El-Deab
data.summary: Abstract Photothermal membranes driven by solar energy represent a promising approach for sustainable and cost-effective desalination and wastewater treatment. Solar energy’s renewability and low environmental impact drive its adoption in desalination technologies. In this work, chemical vapor deposition polymerization (CVDP) is used to deposit high-performance polypyrrole (PPy) coatings on two different fabric types: woven and nonwoven, enabling broad-spectrum solar light absorption and efficient thermal conversion for enhanced water evaporation. This study investigated the efficacy of different oxidizing agents in initiating the CVDP process and in depositing PPy layer on the substrate surface, for use as a photothermal membrane to harvest freshwater and salt from different saline wastewater samples. The goal is to achieve efficient polymerization, targeting pyrrole usage as low as 15 μL for perfect PPy deposition. Among the investigated oxidizing agents, copper chloride and ammonium persulfate yielded the most effective performance in producing PPy-coated photothermal membranes. These membranes demonstrated superior light absorption and achieved surface temperatures of 63 °C and 60 °C under simulated 1 sun illumination (1 kW m − 2 ), showing facilitated enhanced water evaporation rates of 0.95 and 0.93 kg m − 2 h − 1 , respectively. Meanwhile, a a water evaporation rate of 2.91 kg m − 2 h − 1 under 3 sun illumination was obtained. Furthermore, the developed robust photothermal membranes tested against different saline solutions, including NaCl, CuSO 4 .5H 2 O, and FeCl 3 for simultaneous water evaporation and salt harvesting under solar simulator. A developed A4-size photothermal membrane from non-woven fabric was tested using actual brine water sample under natural sunlight for one week. The used photothermal membranes showed the recyclability and durability during the tests.
data.title_cn: 开发坚固的双功能 PPy 光热膜，用于同时收集淡水和盐
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：由太阳能驱动的光热膜代表了一种有前景的可持续且具有成本效益的海水淡化和废水处理方法。太阳能的可再生性和低环境影响推动了其在海水淡化技术中的采用。在这项工作中，化学气相沉积聚合（CVDP）用于在两种不同的织物类型（机织织物和非织造织物）上沉积高性能聚吡咯（PPy）涂层，从而实现广谱太阳光吸收和高效热转换，从而增强水蒸发。本研究研究了不同氧化剂在引发 CVDP 过程和在基材表面沉积 PPy 层方面的功效，以用作光热膜从不同含盐废水样品中收集淡水和盐。目标是实现高效聚合，目标吡咯用量低至 15 μL，以实现完美的 PPy 沉积。在所研究的氧化剂中，氯化铜和过硫酸铵在生产 PPy 涂层光热膜方面表现出最有效的性能。这些膜表现出优异的光吸收性，在模拟 1 个太阳光照 (1 kW m − 2 ) 下，表面温度达到 63 °C 和 60 °C，显示出促进的水蒸发率分别为 0.95 和 0.93 kg m − 2 h − 1 。同时，在3个太阳光照下，水蒸发率为2.91 kg m - 2 h - 1。此外，开发的坚固的光热膜针对不同的盐溶液（包括 NaCl、CuSO 4 .5H 2 O 和 FeCl 3）进行了测试，以便在太阳模拟器下同时进行水蒸发和盐收集。使用实际盐水样品在自然阳光下对开发的 A4 尺寸无纺布光热膜进行一周的测试。使用的光热膜在测试中显示出可回收性和耐用性。

data.title: Psychological distress and problematic social media use among Moroccan youth mediated by fear of missing out and social media engagement
data.author: Samira Abbouyi, Samira Bouazza, Btissame Zarrouq
data.summary: Problematic social media use (PSMU) is an increasing global concern, especially among adolescents and young adults, because of its associations with adverse mental health outcomes such as depression, anxiety, and stress. While much research has been conducted in Western contexts, little is known about PSMU in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, particularly in Morocco. This study estimated PSMU prevalence among Moroccan adolescents and young adults and examined its psychosocial correlates, focusing on psychological distress (depression, anxiety, stress), and tested whether fear of missing out (FoMO) and social media engagement (SME) mediate these relationships. A cross-sectional survey was conducted with N = 2202 adolescents and young adults (1298 females (58.95%), 904 males (41.05%) ; aged 14–23 years). Validated instruments were used to assess PSMU (BSMAS), depression, anxiety, and stress (DASS-21), FoMO, and SME. Statistical analyses included descriptive analyses, correlations, and multiple mediation models. PSMU prevalence was 25.5%, (95% CI [23.7%, 27.3%]) and was higher among females, older adolescents and young adults, urban residents, and participants with lower socioeconomic status. Psychological distress positively associated with PSMU symptoms (BSMAS total), and FoMO and SME partially mediated these associations. The SEM model explained 35% of the variance in PSMU (R² = 0.35). PSMU is highly prevalent among Moroccan adolescents and young adults and was associated with psychological distress, sociodemographic characteristics, and behavioral mediators such as FoMO and SME. These findings highlight the need for culturally tailored prevention and intervention programs to promote healthier social media behaviors and enhance adolescent well-being.
data.title_cn: 摩洛哥青年的心理困扰和社交媒体使用问题是由于害怕错过和社交媒体参与而造成的
data.abstract_cn: 有问题的社交媒体使用 (PSMU) 日益受到全球关注，尤其是在青少年和年轻人中，因为它与抑郁、焦虑和压力等不良心理健康结果有关。尽管在西方背景下进行了大量研究，但人们对中东和北非 (MENA) 地区（尤其是摩洛哥）的 PSMU 知之甚少。这项研究估计了摩洛哥青少年和年轻人中 PSMU 的患病率，并检查了其社会心理相关性，重点关注心理困扰（抑郁、焦虑、压力），并测试了对错过的恐惧 (FoMO) 和社交媒体参与度 (SME) 是否会调节这些关系。对 2202 名青少年和年轻人（1298 名女性（58.95%），904 名男性（41.05%）；年龄 14-23 岁）进行了一项横断面调查。使用经过验证的工具来评估 PSMU (BSMAS)、抑郁、焦虑和压力 (DASS-21)、FoMO 和 SME。统计分析包括描述性分析、相关性和多重中介模型。 PSMU 患病率为 25.5%（95% CI [23.7%, 27.3%]），在女性、老年青少年和年轻人、城市居民以及社会经济地位较低的参与者中较高。心理困扰与 PSMU 症状（BSMAS 总计）呈正相关，FoMO 和 SME 部分介导了这些关联。 SEM 模型解释了 PSMU 中 35% 的方差 (R² = 0.35)。 PSMU 在摩洛哥青少年和年轻人中非常普遍，并且与心理困扰、社会人口特征以及 FoMO 和 SME 等行为中介因素相关。这些发现强调需要制定适合文化的预防和干预计划，以促进更健康的社交媒体行为并增强青少年的福祉。

data.title: SAT: shift alignment transformer for video denoising without flow estimation
data.author: Xing Zhang, Siyuan Fan, Haikun Zhang, Yongji Gao, Yueli Hu
data.summary: Video denoising aims to recover clean video sequences with rich structural details from temporally correlated noisy frames, where the core challenge lies in effectively aggregating long-range temporal information under complex motion conditions. Existing sliding-window and recurrent-based approaches suffer from limited receptive fields or restricted parallelism, while recent Transformer-based methods, although capable of modeling long-range dependencies, are constrained by fixed-window designs that hinder large-scale motion handling. In this paper, we propose a novel and efficient Shift Alignment Transformer (SAT) for video denoising, which enables implicit feature alignment and aggregation over extended spatiotemporal regions without relying on optical flow estimation. The proposed framework introduces two complementary mechanisms: Time Segment Shift, which establishes inter-frame correlations by dynamically shifting temporal windows, and Local Window Shift, which enhances intra-frame contextual modeling through spatial window displacement. Together, these designs enable flexible receptive field expansion while maintaining computational efficiency. Extensive experiments conducted on both synthetic Gaussian noise removal in the RGB domain and real-world video denoising in the RAW domain demonstrate that SAT consistently outperforms or matches state-of-the-art methods in terms of denoising accuracy, while achieving a favorable balance between performance and computational cost. These results indicate that the proposed SAT provides an effective and practical solution for long-range spatiotemporal modeling in video denoising, offering a robust alternative to explicit motion estimation and fixed-window Transformer architectures.
data.title_cn: SAT：用于视频去噪的移位对齐变压器，无需流量估计
data.abstract_cn: 视频去噪旨在从时间相关的噪声帧中恢复具有丰富结构细节的干净视频序列，其核心挑战在于在复杂运动条件下有效聚合长距离时间信息。现有的滑动窗口和基于循环的方法受到有限的感受野或受限的并行性的影响，而最近基于 Transformer 的方法虽然能够建模远程依赖关系，但受到固定窗口设计的限制，阻碍了大规模运动处理。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖且高效的视频去噪移位对齐变换器（SAT），它能够在扩展时空区域上进行隐式特征对齐和聚合，而无需依赖光流估计。所提出的框架引入了两种互补机制：时间段移位（Time Segment Shift）和局部窗口移位（Local Window Shift），前者通过动态移位时间窗口来建立帧间相关性，后者通过空间窗口位移来增强帧内上下文建模。这些设计共同实现了灵活的感受野扩展，同时保持了计算效率。对 RGB 域中的合成高斯噪声去除和 RAW 域中的真实视频去噪进行的大量实验表明，SAT 在去噪精度方面始终优于或匹配最先进的方法，同时在性能和计算成本之间实现了良好的平衡。这些结果表明，所提出的 SAT 为视频去噪中的远程时空建模提供了有效且实用的解决方案，为显式运动估计和固定窗口 Transformer 架构提供了稳健的替代方案。

data.title: Promoting sustainable urban tourism in Historic Sari, Iran through GIS-based walkability planning
data.author: Omid Mansourihanis, Ali Soltani, Mohsen RoohaniQadikolaei
data.summary: Despite tourist attractions such as valuable historical buildings and axes, the historical district of Sari City has failed to attract visitors. By utilizing GIS route optimization and modeling exclusive pedestrian networks, this article seeks to improve walkability and promote tourism. This study concentrates on the Iranian city of Sari and emphasises sustainable urban development and tourism in urban planning. By incorporating the inverse desirability index of each network edge as a cost factor, an optimised tourist route is created that connects and preserves cultural heritage while efficiently connecting historical locations. The research demonstrates the applicability of this methodology to historical cities with comparable characteristics, providing an innovative approach to sidewalk modeling and accessibility analysis. Utilizing a multi-criteria GIS-based approach substantially enhances walkability in historic urban environments, according to the article's findings. The conclusion of the study highlights the creation of a more efficient tourist route in Sari, Iran, as well as its potential for boosting tourism and promoting sustainable urban communities in other historical areas.
data.title_cn: 通过基于 GIS 的步行规划，促进伊朗历史悠久的萨里城的可持续城市旅游业
data.abstract_cn: 尽管有珍贵的历史建筑和轴线等旅游景点，萨里城的历史街区却未能吸引游客。本文旨在通过利用 GIS 路线优化和专属步行网络建模，提高步行适宜性并促进旅游业发展。本研究重点关注伊朗城市萨里，强调城市规划中的可持续城市发展和旅游业。通过将每个网络边缘的逆需求指数作为成本因素，创建一条优化的旅游路线，在有效连接历史地点的同时连接和保护文化遗产。该研究证明了该方法对于具有可比特征的历史城市的适用性，为人行道建模和可达性分析提供了一种创新方法。根据该文章的研究结果，利用基于 GIS 的多标准方法可显着增强历史城市环境中的步行性。该研究的结论强调了在伊朗萨里创建一条更高效的旅游路线，及其在促进其他历史地区旅游业和促进可持续城市社区的潜力。

data.title: Isoflurane aggravates pre-existing proteotoxicity in adult nematodes by suppressing mitochondrial fitness
data.author: Tayir Elami, Huadong Zhu, Reut Bruck-Haimson, Vijigisha Srivastava, Adam Zaretsky, Irit Cohen, Einav Gross, Ehud Cohen
data.summary: Post operative delirium (POD) is an acute complication, characterized by fluctuating attention and confusion, which may develop and persist into cognitive decline. POD is most commonly observed in elderly patients, particularly those with preexisting cognitive impairments. Isoflurane, a widely used volatile anesthetic, is associated with POD. However. how exposure to isoflurane affects the integrity of the proteome is largely obscure. Utilizing the nematode C. elegans, we found that isoflurane leads to a long-lasting decline in protein homeostasis (proteostasis) of adult animals that express neurodegeneration-causing, abnormally long poly-glutamine stretches. Isoflurane-induced proteostasis impairments are dependent on the aging-regulating transcription factors DAF-16/FOXO and SKN-1/NRF, and can be alleviated by the knockdown of certain components of the mitophagy mechanism. Accordingly, induction of mitochondrial biogenesis protects worms that are challenged by protein aggregation from isoflurane-induced proteotoxicity. Our observations provide novel insights into the mechanism that links isoflurane, proteotoxicity and POD, and highlight the potential of mitophagy modulators as alleviators of POD.
data.title_cn: 异氟烷通过抑制线粒体健康来加剧成虫线虫中已有的蛋白质毒性
data.abstract_cn: 术后谵妄 (POD) 是一种急性并发症，其特点是注意力波动和意识混​​乱，可能发展并持续导致认知能力下降。 POD 最常见于老年患者，特别是那些已有认知障碍的患者。异氟烷是一种广泛使用的挥发性麻醉剂，与 POD 有关。然而。暴露于异氟烷如何影响蛋白质组的完整性在很大程度上尚不清楚。利用线虫秀丽隐杆线虫，我们发现异氟醚会导致成年动物的蛋白质稳态（蛋白质稳态）长期下降，这些成年动物表达引起神经变性的异常长的聚谷氨酰胺延伸。异氟烷诱导的蛋白质稳态损伤依赖于衰老调节转录因子 DAF-16/FOXO 和 SKN-1/NRF，并且可以通过敲低线粒体自噬机制的某些成分来缓解。因此，线粒体生物发生的诱导可以保护受到蛋白质聚集挑战的蠕虫免受异氟烷诱导的蛋白质毒性。我们的观察结果为异氟烷、蛋白质毒性和 POD 之间的联系机制提供了新的见解，并强调了线粒体自噬调节剂作为 POD 缓解剂的潜力。

data.title: Orientation modulated piezoelectric patches for active vibration reduction of thick plates using a singular value decomposition-based optimization
data.author: Azin Nadi, Mojtaba Mahzoon, Ehsan Azadi Yazdi
data.summary: Active vibration reduction in thick plates remains a significant challenge in structural control. This study proposes a novel method for optimizing the orientation of piezoelectric sensor/actuator pairs to enhance vibration suppression. The dynamics of thick plates are modeled using Mindlin plate theory and solved using the finite difference method. The optimization problem is addressed using a binary-coded genetic algorithm, with Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of the modified control matrix as the objective function. Numerical simulations on a cantilever thick plate demonstrate that optimizing both patch orientation and location significantly improves vibration reduction. The proposed method achieves an average closed-loop dB gain reduction of up to 25.85% compared to location-only optimization and substantially outperforms both random and thin-plate-based configurations. These results highlight that alignment of piezoelectric patches with local strain directions is critical for maximizing electromechanical coupling and control effectiveness. The present framework offers a robust and efficient approach for designing high-performance active vibration control systems in thick plate structures, highlighting the combined importance of spatial placement and directional alignment for achieving superior performance and resource efficiency.
data.title_cn: 使用基于奇异值分解的优化来主动减少厚板振动的方向调制压电片
data.abstract_cn: 厚板的主动减振仍然是结构控制中的重大挑战。本研究提出了一种优化压电传感器/执行器对的方向以增强振动抑制的新方法。使用 Mindlin 板理论对厚板的动力学进行建模，并使用有限差分法进行求解。使用二进制编码遗传算法解决优化问题，以修改后的控制矩阵的奇异值分解（SVD）作为目标函数。对悬臂厚板的数值模拟表明，优化贴片方向和位置可显着改善减振效果。与仅位置优化相比，所提出的方法实现了平均闭环 dB 增益降低高达 25.85%，并且显着优于随机配置和基于薄板的配置。这些结果强调，压电贴片与局部应变方向的对齐对于最大化机电耦合和控制有效性至关重要。本框架提供了一种稳健而有效的方法，用于设计厚板结构中的高性能主动振动控制系统，强调了空间布局和方向对准对于实现卓越性能和资源效率的综合重要性。

data.title: Neural responses to virtual avatars are shaped by user preference and personality traits
data.author: Ayumi Takemoto, Motoaki Sugiura
data.summary: Abstract This study aimed to investigate individual differences’ effects on brain activity in selected and non-selected avatars for re-engagement. The development of some applications for human–computer interaction has accelerated over the past decade. To develop a human–computer communication system using virtual avatars without losing the user’s interest and attention, this study revealed differences in the neural mechanisms underlying the perception of virtual avatars between avatars with which users want to converse again (selected avatars) and those with which they do not (non-selected avatars). Forty-two individuals were recruited; they watched two videos in sequence in which each virtual avatar greeted them, and they then reported which avatars they wanted to talk to again. Meanwhile, brain activities were recorded by functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). After the fMRI recording, the responses to the questionnaires regarding personality traits and avatar impressions were rated. Brain activities were compared along with the score of each personality questionnaire. The results indicated that the left middle temporal gyrus (MTG) was more active in selected compared to non-selected avatars. Furthermore, the brain activities of right superior frontal gyrus (SFG) and the left middle cingulate gyrus (MCG) had a statistically negative correlation with the score of openness in the Ten-Item Personality Inventory (TIPI) in selected avatars. These findings indicate that neural responses during brief avatar evaluation are associated with both avatar selection outcomes and individual personality differences. While these results do not permit direct inferences about specific psychological processes, they provide an insight into the neural correlates of early-stage avatar preference formation in human–computer interaction.
data.title_cn: 对虚拟化身的神经反应是由用户偏好和个性特征决定的
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：本研究旨在调查个体差异对选定和未选定的重新参与化身的大脑活动的影响。过去十年中，一些人机交互应用程序的发展加速了。为了在不失去用户兴趣和注意力的情况下开发使用虚拟化身的人机通信系统，本研究揭示了用户想要再次交谈的化身（选定的化身）和用户不想与之交谈的化身（非选择的化身）之间虚拟化身感知背后的神经机制的差异。招募了四十二人；他们依次观看了两个视频，其中每个虚拟化身都向他们打招呼，然后他们报告了他们想再次与哪些化身交谈。同时，通过功能磁共振成像（fMRI）记录大脑活动。功能磁共振成像记录后，对有关人格特征和头像印象的问卷回答进行了评分。将大脑活动与每个人格问卷的得分进行比较。结果表明，与未选择的化身相比，选择的化身中的左侧颞中回（MTG）更加活跃。此外，在选定的化身中，右额上回（SFG）和左中扣带回（MCG）的大脑活动与十项人格量表（TIPI）中的开放性得分在统计上呈负相关。这些发现表明，简短的化身评估过程中的神经反应与化身选择结果和个体性格差异相关。虽然这些结果不允许直接推断特定的心理过程，但它们提供了对人机交互中早期化身偏好形成的神经关联的深入了解。

data.title: Autoantibody and disease control stability following mRNA COVID-19 vaccination in rheumatoid arthritis: an observational cohort study
data.author: Takayuki Fujii, Koichi Murata, Shuichiro Nakabo, Akira Onishi, Kosaku Murakami, Masao Tanaka, Akio Morinobu, Shuichi Matsuda
data.summary: To evaluate the long-term impact of mRNA-based COVID-19 vaccination on autoantibody titers, rheumatoid factor (RF) and anti-citrullinated protein antibodies (ACPA), and disease control in rheumatoid arthritis (RA). RA patients with at least five visits before COVID-19 vaccination started were included and categorized by their vaccination status. Changes in RF and ACPA titers were analyzed using generalized linear mixed models to assess intra-patient trends over up to seven vaccine doses. Comparisons of autoantibody titers, seroconversion rates, and disease flares between vaccinated and non-vaccinated patients were performed using weighted generalized linear models with propensity score overlap weighting to adjust for confounding. Among 427 patients (359 vaccinated, 68 non-vaccinated), RF showed a slight but statistically significant decrease after repeated mRNA vaccinations (p < 0.001), while ACPA remained stable (p = 0.325). No significant differences in RF or ACPA were observed between the vaccinated and non-vaccinated patients after covariate adjustment. RF seroconversion occurred in 19.1% of RF-negative vaccinated patients and 11.8% of non-vaccinated patients and ACPA seroconversion occurred in 8.2% of ACPA-negative vaccinated patients and 13.3% of non-vaccinated patients, showing no statistically significant difference. No significant differences were found in the number of disease flares (3.82 ± 4.05 in vaccinated, 4.73 ± 5.38 in non-vaccinated). mRNA-based COVID-19 vaccination did not lead to increased autoantibody titers, seroconversion rates, or disease flare. Instead, successive vaccine doses led to a significant RF decrease, suggesting that the mRNA vaccine has a potentially beneficial immunomodulatory effect and support the safety of repeated boosters in RA.
data.title_cn: 类风湿性关节炎 mRNA COVID-19 疫苗接种后的自身抗体和疾病控制稳定性：一项观察性队列研究
data.abstract_cn: 评估基于 mRNA 的 COVID-19 疫苗接种对自身抗体滴度、类风湿因子 (RF) 和抗瓜氨酸蛋白抗体 (ACPA) 以及类风湿性关节炎 (RA) 疾病控制的长期影响。在开始接种 COVID-19 疫苗之前至少就诊过 5 次的 RA 患者被纳入其中，并按其疫苗接种状况进行分类。使用广义线性混合模型分析 RF 和 ACPA 滴度的变化，以评估最多七剂疫苗剂量的患者内部趋势。使用加权广义线性模型与倾向评分重叠加权来比较已接种疫苗和未接种疫苗的患者之间的自身抗体滴度、血清转化率和疾病发作，以调整混杂因素。在 427 名患者中（359 名接种疫苗的患者，68 名未接种疫苗的患者），重复 mRNA 疫苗接种后，RF 显示出轻微但具有统计学意义的下降 (p < 0.001)，而 ACPA 保持稳定 (p = 0.325)。协变量调整后，接种疫苗和未接种疫苗的患者之间未观察到 RF 或 ACPA 存在显着差异。 RF阴性疫苗接种患者中19.1%发生RF血清转化，未接种疫苗患者中11.8%发生ACPA血清转化，ACPA阴性疫苗接种患者中8.2%发生ACPA血清转化，未接种疫苗患者中ACPA血清转化发生率13.3%，无统计学差异。疾病发作数量没有发现显着差异（接种疫苗的患者为 3.82 ± 4.05，未接种疫苗的患者为 4.73 ± 5.38）。基于 mRNA 的 COVID-19 疫苗接种不会导致自身抗体滴度、血清转化率或疾病发作增加。相反，连续的疫苗剂量导致 RF 显着降低，这表明 mRNA 疫苗具有潜在有益的免疫调节作用，并支持 RA 中重复加强免疫的安全性。

data.title: Age related alteration in EEG evoked responses to balance perturbations on an inclined surface
data.author: Yu Chin Lim, Ananda Sidarta, Pablo Cruz Gonzalez, Jack Jiaqi Zhang, Patrick Wai Hang Kwong, Karen Sui Geok Chua
data.summary: Falls in older adults are often worsened by environmental challenges, such as sloped terrain, which increase the demands on the control of upright stability. Studying cortical activities evoked by perturbations under such conditions can help elucidate the neural mechanisms underlying postural control. This study investigated age-related differences in cortical responses to slope-induced forward perturbations and whether these responses primarily reflect reactive motor control to regain balance. Ten older and ten young adults underwent lean-and-release perturbations on a slope while electroencephalography (EEG) was recorded during reactive stepping and non-stepping blocks, presented in a counterbalanced order. Analyses included event-related potentials, spectral dynamics, and graph theory approaches. Older adults showed delayed and reduced N100 responses compared to younger adults, with no differences between stepping conditions. Event-related spectral perturbations showed reduced post-perturbation theta and beta power synchronization in older adults. Network analysis indicated higher clustering coefficients and greater global efficiency in older adults compared to younger adults, particularly in the theta band. Similar early cortical activities across conditions suggest that perturbation-evoked responses are mainly driven by the detection of imbalance. These empirical results highlight the neural basis of age-related changes in postural adjustment, offering a potential outcome measure for targeted interventions.
data.title_cn: 脑电图的年龄相关变化引起对倾斜表面上的平衡扰动的反应
data.abstract_cn: 老年人的跌倒往往会因环境挑战而恶化，例如倾斜的地形，这增加了对直立稳定性控制的要求。研究这种条件下扰动引起的皮层活动可以帮助阐明姿势控制背后的神经机制。这项研究调查了皮层对斜坡引起的向前扰动的反应与年龄相关的差异，以及这些反应是否主要反映了恢复平衡的反应性运动控制。十名老年人和十名年轻人在斜坡上经历倾斜和释放扰动，同时在反应性踏步和非踏步块期间记录脑电图（EEG），并以平衡顺序呈现。分析包括事件相关电位、谱动力学和图论方法。与年轻人相比，老年人的 N100 反应延迟且降低，但迈步条件之间没有差异。与事件相关的光谱扰动表明，老年人扰动后 θ 和 β 功率同步性降低。网络分析表明，与年轻人相比，老年人具有更高的聚类系数和更高的整体效率，特别是在 θ 波段。不同条件下类似的早期皮质活动表明，扰动诱发的反应主要是由不平衡的检测驱动的。这些实证结果强调了与年龄相关的姿势调整变化的神经基础，为有针对性的干预措施提供了潜在的结果衡量标准。

data.title: O-RAID: a satellite constellation architecture for ultra-resilient global data backup
data.author: R. G. N. Meegama
data.summary: Growing global data volumes and the increasing frequency of climate-related and geopolitical threats highlight the need for ultra-resilient backup infrastructures. This paper proposes a novel Satellite-RAID architecture, named O-RAID, in which clusters of satellites operate as a distributed redundant array of independent disks (RAID), enabling large-scale cold and warm backup storage in Earth’s orbit. Unlike previous work on space-based computing or satellite cloud relays, this research presents a formal design for orbital storage redundancy, inter-satellite parity exchange, latency-tolerant RAID protocols and power provisioning using a geostationary solar-energy beam. To establish a foundation for quantifying system resilience, we develop a reliability framework based on a Continuous-Time Markov Chain (CTMC) model, defining the states and transition rates for future survivability analysis of an orbital RAID equivalent. The paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the system architecture, its core components and the mathematical underpinnings for erasure coding and communication. An in-depth examination of system feasibility, survivability simulations, key constraints and communication overhead is presented, concluding that orbital backup storage presents a viable and promising paradigm for national archives, disaster-resilient storage and long-term scientific data preservation with technical readiness projected by 2035.
data.title_cn: O-RAID：用于超弹性全局数据备份的卫星星座架构
data.abstract_cn: 全球数据量的不断增长以及气候相关和地缘政治威胁的日益频繁，凸显了对超弹性备份基础设施的需求。本文提出了一种新颖的卫星RAID架构，称为O-RAID，其中卫星集群作为独立磁盘的分布式冗余阵列（RAID）运行，从而实现地球轨道上的大规模冷热备份存储。与之前的天基计算或卫星云中继工作不同，这项研究提出了轨道存储冗余、卫星间奇偶校验交换、耐延迟 RAID 协议和使用对地静止太阳能光束供电的正式设计。为了建立量化系统弹性的基础，我们开发了一个基于连续时间马尔可夫链 (CTMC) 模型的可靠性框架，定义了轨道 RAID 等效项未来生存性分析的状态和转换率。本文对系统架构、核心组件以及纠删码和通信的数学基础进行了全面分析。对系统可行性、生存性模拟、关键约束和通信开销进行了深入研究，得出的结论是，轨道备份存储为国家档案、抗灾存储和长期科学数据保存提供了一种可行且有前途的范例，预计到 2035 年技术准备就绪。

data.title: Turbulence and particle dynamics in volcanic clouds in humid atmospheres
data.author: Florencia Zapata, Pablo D. Mininni, S. Ravichandran, Corrado Cimarelli, Mie Ichihara
data.summary: The eruption of Hunga Tonga–Hunga Ha’apai (HTHH), which began around 04:00 UTC on January 15, 2022, injected substantial amounts of water vapor above the stratosphere. The subsequent explosions occurred in an exceptionally humid environment. Although the massive umbrella cloud produced by the initial explosion obscured direct observation, volcanic lightning provided information about the later events. This prompts a reevaluation of how atmospheric and eruption-driven moisture affect plume dynamics and turbulent particle collisions within volcanic clouds, particularly under humidity conditions that greatly exceed those previously assumed. We conducted high-resolution simulations using a non-hydrostatic, stably stratified moist atmospheric model coupled with inertial particles. Our model incorporates a novel formulation that enables independent control of atmospheric and plume-source moisture. The simulations reproduce ring-shaped turbulent regions observed as lightning rings during the HTHH eruption pulses, and show that increased humidity compresses the turbulent regions inward and enhances upward transport. Additionally, the model captures oscillatory plume height behavior associated with gravity waves modulated by moisture. These findings shed light on a previously unexplored coupling between moisture, turbulence, and particles in volcanic eruptions. They also offer a framework for inferring internal plume properties and source parameters in successive eruptions obscured by pre-existing volcanic clouds.
data.title_cn: 潮湿大气中火山云的湍流和粒子动力学
data.abstract_cn: 洪加汤加-洪加哈派 (HTHH) 喷发于世界标准时间 2022 年 1 月 15 日凌晨 04:00 左右开始，向平流层上方注入了大量水蒸气。随后的爆炸发生在异常潮湿的环境中。尽管最初爆炸产生的巨大伞云遮蔽了直接观察，但火山闪电提供了有关后来事件的信息。这促使人们重新评估大气和喷发驱动的水分如何影响火山云内的羽流动力学和湍流粒子碰撞，特别是在远远超出先前假设的湿度条件下。我们使用非静水、稳定分层的潮湿大气模型与惯性粒子相结合进行了高分辨率模拟。我们的模型采用了一种新颖的配方，可以独立控制大气和羽流源湿度。模拟再现了 HTHH 喷发脉冲期间观察到的闪电环形式的环形湍流区域，并表明湿度的增加将湍流区域向内压缩并增强了向上传输。此外，该模型还捕获与湿度调制的重力波相关的振荡羽流高度行为。这些发现揭示了火山喷发中水分、湍流和颗粒之间以前未探索过的耦合。它们还提供了一个框架，用于推断被预先存在的火山云遮蔽的连续喷发中的内部羽流特性和源参数。

data.title: Near-care assay of plasma glial fibrillary acid protein and ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase isozyme L1 with shorter and prolonged duration exercise
data.author: Michael John Stacey, Amanda Barden, Daniel Snape, Barney Wainwright, Iain Parsons, Todd Leckie, Daniel Fitzpatrick, Gerasimos Grivas, Yannis Pitsiladis, Tom Palin, John O’Hara, David Woods
data.summary: Abstract Neurobiomarkers measured in peripheral blood can supplement management strategies following traumatic brain injury (TBI). Dual-assay of glial fibrillary acid protein (GFAP) and ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase isozyme L1 (UCHL1) is FDA-approved to inform a decision threshold approach (GFAP > 30 µg.L − 1 and/or UCHL1 > 360 µg.L − 1 ) for post-TBI neuroimaging. As physical activity and thermal strain often accompany TBI-prone activities, we investigated whether each molecule’s quantification - and, by extension, clinical decisions - could be influenced by exercise-heat stress. In healthy volunteers monitored continuously for body core temperature (Tc), we used the i-STAT Alinity to assess plasma GFAP and UCHL1 responses to exercise in the laboratory (four female, eighteen male trained participants, cycling for 45 min in 32 °C) and field (three female and 22 male recreational marathon runners, finishing time 231 ± 34 min, peak ambient temperature 11 °C). Respective ΔTc overall were 1.42 ± 0.37 °C and 1.87 [1.53, 2.31] °C. With laboratory exercise, GFAP and UCHL1 did not exceed the manufacturer’s decision threshold. Across the marathon, GFAP was stable, whereas UCH-L1 more than doubled (200 [200, 200] vs. 462 [310, 782] µg.L-1, P < 0.0001), breaching the decision threshold for neuroimaging in 18/25 runners. Confounding from more severe exercise-heat stress should be considered when interpreting near-care assay of UCHL1 for TBI management.
data.title_cn: 较短和长时间运动时血浆胶质纤维酸性蛋白和泛素羧基末端水解酶同工酶 L1 的近距离检测
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 外周血中测量的神经生物标志物可以补充创伤性脑损伤 (TBI) 后的治疗策略。胶质纤维酸性蛋白 (GFAP) 和泛素羧基末端水解酶同工酶 L1 (UCHL1) 的双重检测已获得 FDA 批准，可为 TBI 后神经影像学的决策阈值方法（GFAP > 30 µg.L - 1 和/或 UCHL1 > 360 µg.L - 1）提供信息。由于体力活动和热应变通常伴随着容易发生 TBI 的活动，因此我们研究了每个分子的量化（以及由此延伸的临床决策）是否会受到运动热应激的影响。在连续监测身体核心温度 (Tc) 的健康志愿者中，我们使用 i-STAT Alinity 评估血浆 GFAP 和 UCHL1 对实验室（四名女性、十八名男性受训参与者，在 32 °C 下骑自行车 45 分钟）和现场（三名女性和 22 名男性休闲马拉松运动员，完成时间 231 ± 34 分钟，峰值环境温度 11 °C）运动的反应。各自的总体 ΔTc 分别为 1.42 ± 0.37 °C 和 1.87 [1.53, 2.31] °C。通过实验室测试，GFAP 和 UCHL1 没有超过制造商的决策阈值。在整个马拉松比赛中，GFAP 保持稳定，而 UCH-L1 增加了一倍多（200 [200, 200] vs. 462 [310, 782] µg.L-1，P < 0.0001），突破了 18/25 跑步者神经影像学的决策阈值。在解释用于 TBI 管理的 UCHL1 近护理检测时，应考虑更严重的运动热应激带来的混淆。

data.title: Highly sensitive profiling somatic mutations of thyroid cancer by nucleotide-enrichment-based MALDI-TOF MS assay
data.author: Huili Bai, Ying Li, Jia Li, Ting Liu, Jun Xiao, Lihui Xia, Xueqin Sun, Wei Cheng
data.summary: Multiple mutation detection is increasingly essential for clinical applications targeting the diagnosis, treatment decision-making, and prognosis assessment of thyroid cancer, especially for the limited amount of thyroid fine-needle aspiration (FNA) samples. However, there is a lack of cost-effective methods that can simultaneously achieve high sensitivity and high throughput for thyroid cancer. Herein, we present a novel multiplex mutation detection technology that integrates nucleotide enrichment (NE)-assisted specific identification of variant alleles with matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF MS), termed NE-MS, enabling the simultaneous identification of 26 somatic hotspot mutations in thyroid cancer. This method enhances sensitivity by removing the mass-modified dideoxynucleotide (ddNTP) matching the wild-type from the nucleotide mixture during the single-base extension reaction, leaving the mutant alleles available for analysis. NE-MS exhibits an 8-fold lower LOD compared to the regular MS method. This strategy provided an excellent diagnostic performance for thyroid cancer, revealing that multiple mutations are associated with poor prognosis in thyroid cancer patients. Accordingly, this study demonstrated that the NE-MS assay is a highly sensitive and reliable initial screening method for somatic mutation detection, as well as a diagnostic and prognostic tool for thyroid nodules.
data.title_cn: 通过基于核苷酸富集的 MALDI-TOF MS 测定法对甲状腺癌的体细胞突变进行高灵敏度分析
data.abstract_cn: 多重突变检测对于甲状腺癌的诊断、治疗决策和预后评估的临床应用越来越重要，特别是对于有限的甲状腺细针抽吸（FNA）样本。然而，目前缺乏能够同时实现甲状腺癌高灵敏度和高通量的经济有效的方法。在此，我们提出了一种新型多重突变检测技术，将核苷酸富集（NE）辅助的变异等位基因特异性识别与基质辅助激光解吸/电离飞行时间质谱（MALDI-TOF MS）相结合，称为NE-MS，能够同时识别甲状腺癌中的26种体细胞热点突变。该方法通过在单碱基延伸反应期间从核苷酸混合物中去除与野生型匹配的质量修饰双脱氧核苷酸 (ddNTP) 来增强灵敏度，从而使突变等位基因可用于分析。与常规 MS 方法相比，NE-MS 的 LOD 低 8 倍。该策略为甲状腺癌提供了出色的诊断性能，揭示了多种突变与甲状腺癌患者的不良预后相关。因此，本研究表明，NE-MS检测是一种高度灵敏且可靠的体细胞突变检测初步筛选方法，也是甲状腺结节的诊断和预后工具。

data.title: Normalized Caputo–Fabrizio SVIR modeling and bifurcation analysis
data.author: Ramsha Shafqat, Ashraf Al-Quran, Ateq Alsaadi, Abdelhamid Mohammed Djaouti
data.summary: This study presents a comprehensive formulation, theoretical analysis, and numerical investigation of a fractional-order SVIR epidemic model employing the normalized Caputo–Fabrizio (NCF) derivative. The NCF operator introduces memory effects through a normalized, non-singular kernel, ensuring physically consistent weighting of past states. Vaccination dynamics are explicitly incorporated, enabling realistic modeling of epidemic control strategies. We establish key mathematical properties of the model, including existence, uniqueness, positivity, boundedness, and conservation of the total population, and propose an efficient numerical scheme for its simulation. The influence of the fractional order and kernel normalization is explored through numerical experiments, highlighting their impact on epidemic peak magnitude, transient dynamics, and vaccination effectiveness. A rigorous equilibrium and bifurcation analysis shows that, for the closed SVIR structure with constant vaccination, neither backward bifurcation nor Hopf bifurcation can occur, even in the presence of saturated incidence. Any oscillatory behavior observed numerically is transient and induced by fractional memory effects rather than sustained periodic solutions. These results clarify the dynamical limitations of the closed NCF–SVIR framework and highlight the role of fractional memory in shaping epidemic trajectories. The proposed model provides a robust foundation for future extensions incorporating demographic turnover or imperfect vaccination, where richer bifurcation phenomena may arise.
data.title_cn: 归一化 Caputo–Fabrizio SVIR 建模和分岔分析
data.abstract_cn: 本研究采用归一化 Caputo–Fabrizio (NCF) 导数对分数阶 SVIR 流行病模型进行了全面的表述、理论分析和数值研究。 NCF 算子通过标准化的非奇异内核引入记忆效应，确保过去状态的物理一致权重。明确纳入疫苗接种动态，从而能够对流行病控制策略进行现实建模。我们建立了模型的关键数学属性，包括总人口的存在性、唯一性、正性、有界性和守恒性，并为其模拟提出了有效的数值方案。通过数值实验探讨了分数阶和核归一化的影响，强调了它们对流行病峰值幅度、瞬态动态和疫苗接种有效性的影响。严格的平衡和分岔分析表明，对于恒定疫苗接种的封闭SVIR结构，即使存在饱和发生率，也不会发生后向分岔和Hopf分岔。数值观察到的任何振荡行为都是瞬态的，并且是由分数记忆效应而不是持续的周期解引起的。这些结果阐明了封闭式 NCF-SVIR 框架的动力学局限性，并强调了部分记忆在塑造流行病轨迹中的作用。所提出的模型为未来的扩展提供了坚实的基础，包括人口流动或不完善的疫苗接种，其中可能会出现更丰富的分叉现象。

data.title: When LLMs speak ZigBee: exploring low-latency and reasoning models for network traffic generation
data.author: Nur Keleşoğlu, Łukasz Sobczak, Joanna Domańska
data.summary: The generation of realistic network traffic is a critical requirement for testing, simulation, and security evaluation in ZigBee-based IoT systems. In this study, we propose a novel framework that extracts sample ZigBee traffic packets and generates semantically meaningful and protocol-compliant synthetic traffic using Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-4.1 and GPT-5. Unlike traditional rule-based or statistical generators, our approach is data-driven and incorporates sample-based few-shot learning, prompt engineering, and a human-in-the-loop feedback mechanism. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, we conduct two sets of experiments. The first focuses on generating unidirectional traffic to emulate typical device-to-hub communication, while the second extends this setup to bidirectional exchanges, capturing realistic request–response dynamics and interaction patterns. The realism of the generated traffic is assessed using a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that includes statistical similarity measures, such as Jensen–Shannon Divergence, as well as protocol compliance, semantic correctness, temporal consistency, and diversity metrics. In addition, we compare the performance of LLM-based generators with classical deep learning baselines, including recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and generative adversarial networks (GANs). We further analyze the computational cost and the impact of internal reasoning effort on traffic generation by systematically evaluating different GPT-5 reasoning configurations. Experimental results show that both GPT-4.1 and GPT-5 successfully learn the temporal and structural dependencies of ZigBee traffic and significantly outperform RNN and GAN baselines in terms of semantic correctness and long-duration generation. Across all experiments, GPT-4.1 consistently generates traffic that more closely resembles real ZigBee traffic while requiring substantially lower computational resources. These findings highlight that low-latency, non-reasoning LLMs can be particularly well suited for highly structured, protocol-constrained network traffic generation tasks, and demonstrate the potential of LLM-based approaches for realistic IoT traffic generation in research and security evaluation.
data.title_cn: 当法学硕士谈论 ZigBee：探索网络流量生成的低延迟和推理模型
data.abstract_cn: 生成真实的网络流量是基于 ZigBee 的物联网系统中测试、模拟和安全评估的关键要求。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架提取示例 ZigBee 流量数据包，并使用 GPT-4.1 和 GPT-5 等大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成语义有意义且符合协议的合成流量。与传统的基于规则或统计生成器不同，我们的方法是数据驱动的，并结合了基于样本的小样本学习、提示工程和人机交互反馈机制。为了评估所提出框架的有效性，我们进行了两组实验。第一个侧重于生成单向流量以模拟典型的设备到集线器通信，而第二个将此设置扩展到双向交换，捕获真实的请求响应动态和交互模式。使用多维评估框架评估生成流量的真实性，该框架包括统计相似性度量，例如 Jensen-Shannon Divergence，以及协议合规性、语义正确性、时间一致性和多样性度量。此外，我们还将基于 LLM 的生成器的性能与经典深度学习基线（包括循环神经网络（RNN）和生成对抗网络（GAN））进行了比较。我们通过系统地评估不同的 GPT-5 推理配置，进一步分析计算成本以及内部推理工作对流量生成的影响。实验结果表明，GPT-4.1 和 GPT-5 都成功学习了 ZigBee 流量的时间和结构依赖性，并且在语义正确性和长时间生成方面显着优于 RNN 和 GAN 基线。在所有实验中，GPT-4.1 始终生成更接近真实 ZigBee 流量的流量，同时所需的计算资源显着降低。这些发现强调，低延迟、非推理的 LLM 特别适合高度结构化、协议约束的网络流量生成任务，并展示了基于 LLM 的方法在研究和安全评估中用于实际物联网流量生成的潜力。

data.title: Identification of ubiquitination-related signature genes for predicting kidney transplant rejection
data.author: Zhengfei Shan, Shengqiang Yu, Jiantao Wang, Jianxin Cui, Haijian Wei, Xiaohua Fu, Chen Zhang, Chengjun Zhang
data.summary: Kidney transplant rejection (KTR) poses significant challenges to long-term graft survival, with involvement from ubiquitination-related genes (URGs) in immune modulation. This study aimed to identify key URGs linked to KTR and develop a predictive model for rejection risk. mRNA array data from the Gene Expression Omnibus were analyzed to find differentially expressed genes in GSE98320, which were intersected with URGs to yield 16 DE-URGs. Gene Ontology and KEGG enrichment analysis highlighted the NF-kappa B and TNF signaling pathways. A URGScore model stratified patients and revealed significant differences in immune cell infiltration, especially among Treg cells, demonstrating strong predictive performance in the discovery cohort (AUC = 0.774, 95% CI 0.747–0.800). Six signature genes (DTX3L, MARCH1, NCF4, RNF125, TRIM21, TRIM22) were identified, and their expression displayed a subtype-dependent gradient, increasing from antibody-mediated rejection to T cell-mediated rejection and reaching the highest levels in mixed rejection. These genes were incorporated into a nomogram, which achieved an AUC of 0.771 (95% CI 0.745–0.798). Validation in independent datasets confirmed the model’s reliability. In the two transplant rejection cases, MARCH1 and RNF125 showed higher expression than the other biopsy samples, while generalized high expression of all marker genes was observed in an IgA nephropathy patient. Together, these findings demonstrate the clinical relevance of URG-based biomarkers in KTR and provide molecular insight into immune-mediated rejection.
data.title_cn: 鉴定泛素化相关特征基因以预测肾移植排斥
data.abstract_cn: 肾移植排斥（KTR）对移植物的长期存活构成重大挑战，因为泛素化相关基因（URG）参与免疫调节。本研究旨在确定与 KTR 相关的关键 URG，并开发排斥风险的预测模型。分析来自 Gene Expression Omnibus 的 mRNA 阵列数据，以发现 GSE98320 中差异表达的基因，将其与 URG 相交以产生 16 个 DE-URG。基因本体论和 KEGG 富集分析强调了 NF-kappa B 和 TNF 信号通路。 URGScore 模型对患者进行分层，揭示了免疫细胞浸润的显着差异，尤其是 Treg 细胞，在发现队列中表现出强大的预测性能（AUC = 0.774，95% CI 0.747-0.800）。鉴定出 6 个特征基因（DTX3L、MARCH1、NCF4、RNF125、TRIM21、TRIM22），其表达呈现亚型依赖性梯度，从抗体介导的排斥增加到 T 细胞介导的排斥，并在混合排斥中达到最高水平。这些基因被纳入列线图，其 AUC 为 0.771 (95% CI 0.745–0.798)。独立数据集的验证证实了该模型的可靠性。在两例移植排斥病例中，MARCH1和RNF125的表达高于其他活检样本，而在IgA肾病患者中观察到所有标记基因普遍高表达。总之，这些发现证明了 KTR 中基于 URG 的生物标志物的临床相关性，并为免疫介导的排斥提供了分子洞察。

data.title: Transmitter-assisted joint data-aided channel estimation and PAPR reduction scheme in wireless fading channels
data.author: Inaamullah Khan, Mohammad Mahmudul Hasan, Michael Cheffena
data.summary: This paper presents a novel transmitter-assisted joint scheme that simultaneously addresses two critical challenges in modern wireless communication systems: peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) reduction and accurate channel estimation. The proposed solution integrates modified gamma correction commanding (MGCC) with data-aided channel estimation (DACE) for both single-input single-output (SISO) and multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) wireless systems. The key novelty lies in the unique dual-functionality approach, where high-peak power carriers, traditionally a source of distortion due to high PAPR, are repurposed as additional pilot signals at the receiver for improved channel estimation. This innovative use of MGCC not only optimizes the identification and utilization of these carriers but also ensures that the selection of reliable data carriers remains unaffected. By transforming the high PAPR problem into a performance advantage, the scheme significantly reduces the computational complexity typically associated with separate PAPR reduction and channel estimation processes, making it particularly suitable for low-complexity wireless devices. The proposed approach determines peak-powered subcarriers entirely from the transmitted signal, eliminating the need for receiver-to-transmitter feedback and thereby simplifying system design without compromising performance. Furthermore, the study identifies optimal companding parameters to achieve an effective balance between error performance and PAPR reduction. Extensive simulations under Rayleigh and Rician fading channels with varying tap configurations demonstrate the robustness and versatility of the proposed scheme. Performance evaluations, including mean square error and bit-error-rate analyses, confirm the superiority of the proposed approach when paired with least square and linear minimum mean square error channel estimators. The impact of receive antenna correlation on error performance is also analyzed, revealing a nonlinear trend where low correlation levels have minimal effect, while variation in correlation influences system behavior. The results highlight consistent and reliable performance across diverse fading environments, underscoring the potential of the proposed scheme to enhance the efficiency and reliability of next-generation wireless communication systems.
data.title_cn: 无线衰落信道中发射机辅助联合数据辅助信道估计和 PAPR 降低方案
data.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖的发射机辅助联合方案，该方案同时解决了现代无线通信系统中的两个关键挑战：峰均功率比（PAPR）降低和准确的信道估计。所提出的解决方案将修改伽马校正命令 (MGCC) 与数据辅助信道估计 (DACE) 集成在一起，适用于单输入单输出 (SISO) 和多输入多输出 (MIMO) 正交频分复用 (OFDM) 无线系统。关键的新颖之处在于独特的双功能方法，其中高峰值功率载波（传统上由于高 PAPR 导致的失真源）被重新用作接收器处的附加导频信号，以改进信道估计。 MGCC 的这种创新使用不仅优化了这些载体的识别和利用，而且确保了可靠数据载体的选择不受影响。通过将高 PAPR 问题转化为性能优势，该方案显着降低了通常与单独的 PAPR 降低和信道估计过程相关的计算复杂性，使其特别适合低复杂性无线设备。所提出的方法完全根据发射信号确定峰值功率子载波，消除了接收器到发射器反馈的需要，从而在不影响性能的情况下简化了系统设计。此外，该研究还确定了最佳压扩参数，以实现误码性能和 PAPR 降低之间的有效平衡。在具有不同抽头配置的瑞利和莱斯衰落信道下进行的广泛模拟证明了所提出方案的鲁棒性和多功能性。性能评估（包括均方误差和误码率分析）证实了所提出的方法与最小二乘和线性最小均方误差信道估计器配合使用时的优越性。还分析了接收天线相关性对误码性能的影响，揭示了一种非线性趋势，其中低相关水平的影响最小，而相关性的变化会影响系统行为。结果强调了在不同衰落环境下的一致和可靠的性能，强调了所提出的方案在提高下一代无线通信系统的效率和可靠性方面的潜力。

data.title: Microscopic insight into the role of PVDF in improving the phototronic properties of a tin-derived perovskite in their nanocomposite
data.author: Abbas Heshmati Jannat Magham, Afsaneh Rezaei, Davood Ajloo
data.summary: In this study, we investigated the possibility of nanocomposite formation between polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) and perovskite Cs2SnF3I3 using density functional theory (DFT). The Gibbs free energy changes of about − 23 kcal/mol observed during the formation of the complexes indicates that this process is thermodynamically feasible. The NBO and AIM results also confirmed that the interactions of a physical nature at several points between PVDF and this perovskite cause this favorable interaction. The gap energy value of Cs2SnF3I3 3.629 eV and its composites were obtained 3.255 eV, which indicates that their optical excitation occurs at short wavelengths of light, namely near ultraviolet and violet-blue. The study of UV-vis spectra of this perovskite and its complexes with PVDF showed that the creation of composites, in addition to changing the wavelength of absorption peaks towards visible light, can also increase the absorption intensity. The polarity study also showed that due to the composite of Cs2SnF3I3 with PVDF, its dipole moment increased from 10.28 to 14.71 Debye. In addition, the polarizability coefficient and the first hyperpolarizability coefficient also increased with the increase in the number of perovskite units in the composites, improving their optical properties.
data.title_cn: 微观洞察 PVDF 在改善纳米复合材料中锡衍生钙钛矿的光电子性能方面的作用
data.abstract_cn: 在这项研究中，我们利用密度泛函理论（DFT）研究了聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF）和钙钛矿Cs2SnF3I3形成纳米复合材料的可能性。在配合物形成过程中观察到的吉布斯自由能变化约为−23 kcal/mol，表明该过程在热力学上是可行的。 NBO 和 AIM 结果还证实，PVDF 和这种钙钛矿之间多个点上物理性质的相互作用导致了这种有利的相互作用。 Cs2SnF3I3及其复合物的带隙能量值为3.629 eV，为3.255 eV，这表明它们的光学激发发生在短波长的光，即近紫外和紫蓝色光下。对这种钙钛矿及其与 PVDF 的复合物的紫外-可见光谱的研究表明，复合材料的创建除了将吸收峰的波长改变为可见光外，还可以增加吸收强度。极性研究还表明，由于Cs2SnF3I3与PVDF复合，其偶极矩从10.28增加到14.71德拜。此外，极化系数和第一超极化系数也随着复合材料中钙钛矿单元数量的增加而增加，从而改善了其光学性能。

data.title: Parameters associated with the size of the foveal avascular zone in healthy elderly eyes
data.author: Taiji Hasegawa, Kyosuke Nonaka, Tasuku Onishi, Ichiro Maruko
data.summary: To determine parameters related to the size of the foveal avascular zone (FAZ) in healthy elderly eyes. We reviewed the medical records of 101 normal elderly eyes with a mean age of 64.2 ± 10.1 years. A 3 × 3 mm area centered on the fovea was analyzed in optical coherence tomography angiographic images. The center of FAZ and the center of foveal photoreceptors were identified, and the misalignment between the two center points was measured. The mean FAZ size was 0.35 ± 0.12 mm2. The distance between the center of the FAZ and the center of the foveal photoreceptors was 41.6 ± 21.1 μm. The misalignment distance between the center of the FAZ and the center of the foveal photoreceptors was not significantly correlated with the size of the FAZ (r = 0.091, P = 0.3656). On the other hand, there was a significant correlation between the directionality of horizontal and vertical misalignments from the center of the foveal photoreceptors to the center of the FAZ and the FAZ size (r = -0.264, P = 0.0076 horizontal; r = 0.212, P = 0.0335, vertical). These results indicate that the larger the misalignment of the center of the FAZ from the center of the foveal photoreceptors in the temporal and superior directions, the larger the FAZ tended to be. In conclusion, analysis of parameters related to FAZ size in healthy elderly eyes may provide clues to age-related changes in macular microcirculation and early pathology in eyes with retinal diseases.
data.title_cn: 与健康老年人眼中心凹无血管区大小相关的参数
data.abstract_cn: 确定与健康老年人眼中心凹无血管区 (FAZ) 大小相关的参数。我们回顾了 101 名正常老年眼睛的医疗记录，平均年龄为 64.2 ± 10.1 岁。在光学相干断层扫描血管造影图像中分析以中央凹为中心的 3 × 3 mm 区域。确定 FAZ 中心和中心凹感光器中心，并测量两个中心点之间的错位。 FAZ 平均尺寸为 0.35 ± 0.12 mm2。 FAZ 中心与中心凹感光器中心之间的距离为 41.6 ± 21.1 μm。 FAZ 中心与中心凹感光器中心之间的错位距离与 FAZ 大小没有显着相关性（r = 0.091，P = 0.3656）。另一方面，从中心凹感光器中心到 FAZ 中心的水平和垂直错位的方向性与 FAZ 大小之间存在显着相关性（水平方向 r = -0.264，P = 0.0076；垂直方向 r = 0.212，P = 0.0335）。这些结果表明，FAZ的中心与中央凹光感受器的中心在时间方向和上方方向上的错位越大，FAZ趋向于越大。总之，对健康老年人眼睛 FAZ 大小相关参数的分析可能为黄斑微循环的年龄相关变化和患有视网膜疾病的眼睛的早期病理提供线索。

data.title: Designing multisource blue–green cooling networks by coupling landscape pattern metrics and circuit theory
data.author: Yuting Xu, Majing Jiang, Qinglin Li, Benfeng Yu, Khai Ern Lee
data.summary: The surface urban heat island effect is a growing environmental concern amid accelerating urbanisation and climate change, posing significant threats to sustainable development and public health. While urban green spaces are recognised as effective in mitigating the surface urban heat island effect, most studies focused on isolated patches or local interventions, and thus lack a systematic, network-based cooling strategy. This study proposes an integrated framework of “cool-source identification–ventilation corridors–network integration”, combining multi-source remote sensing data (2003–2022), the geographic detector model, morphological spatial pattern analysis, and circuit theory to assess surface urban heat island dynamics and construct an urban green cooling network. Focusing on Nanchang’s central urban area, results indicate that from 2003 to 2022, the proportion of low-temperature zones decreased from 41.69% to 19.67%, while high-temperature zones increased from 8.69% to 19.89%; correspondingly, the surface heat island imbalance index rose from − 0.491 to 0.005. The interaction between the normalised difference vegetation index and land use explained over 60% of the surface temperature variation. A green ecological network comprising 56 primary and 60 secondary ventilation corridors was established, significantly enhancing connectivity and heat dissipation potential. Building on previous studies, this network demonstrates the capacity to reduce daytime temperatures by 1–3 °C in densely built-up areas. The findings highlight that optimising the spatial configuration and connectivity of green spaces can maximise cooling benefits under land constraints. This blue–green ventilation integrated approach provides transferable insights for humid, flat and rapidly urbanising regions.
data.title_cn: 通过耦合景观模式指标和电路理论来设计多源蓝绿冷却网络
data.abstract_cn: 随着城市化进程加快和气候变化，地表城市热岛效应成为日益严重的环境问题，对可持续发展和公众健康构成重大威胁。虽然城市绿地被认为可以有效缓解城市地表热岛效应，但大多数研究都集中在孤立的斑块或局部干预措施上，因此缺乏系统的、基于网络的冷却策略。本研究提出了“冷源识别-通风走廊-网络集成”的综合框架，结合多源遥感数据（2003-2022）、地理探测器模型、形态空间格局分析和回路理论，评估地表城市热岛动态并构建城市绿色冷却网络。以南昌中心城区为研究对象，结果表明，2003年至2022年，低温区所占比重由41.69%下降至19.67%，高温区所占比重由8.69%上升至19.89%；相应地，地表热岛不平衡指数从-0.491上升至0.005。归一化差异植被指数与土地利用之间的相互作用解释了 60% 以上的地表温度变化。建立了由56条一级通风廊道和60条二级通风廊道组成的绿色生态网络，显着增强了连通性和散热潜力。在之前的研究基础上，该网络展示了在建筑密集地区将白天温度降低 1-3°C 的能力。研究结果强调，优化绿色空间的空间配置和连通性可以在土地限制下最大限度地提高冷却效益。这种蓝绿通风综合方法为潮湿、平坦和快速城市化的地区提供了可转移的见解。

data.title: Genomic and in vitro characterization of two lytic bacteriophages infecting multidrug-resistant Erwinia sp. strain AnSW2-5
data.author: Kiwoon Baek, Jaeduk Goh, Ahoung Choi
data.summary: Abstract Multidrug-resistant (MDR) Erwinia pathogens present a critical threat to global crop health and agricultural sustainability. In this study, we characterized two novel lytic bacteriophages, AnSW2-5-P-A (family Autographiviridae ) and AnSW2-5-P-K (class Caudoviricetes ), targeting the MDR Erwinia sp. strain AnSW2-5. Comparative genomics and TEM analysis revealed distinct virion architectures and confirmed the absence of lysogeny-associated genes, ensuring their safety as biocontrol agents. One-step growth assays demonstrated that P-A has a shorter latent period (~ 20 min), while P-K exhibits a significantly larger burst size (~ 110 PFU/cell). In co-culture assays, the dual-phage cocktail demonstrated a profound synergistic effect, achieving > 80% bacterial reduction ( p < 0.05) and maintaining sustained suppression of the host for 72 h. Notably, the cocktail effectively prevented the emergence of resistant mutants, reducing the frequency of resistance ( FoR ) to below the limit of detection (< 10⁻⁸). These findings highlight the potential of using genetically diverse phage pairs with complementary lytic activities as a robust, resistance-suppressive biocontrol strategy against MDR phytopathogens.
data.title_cn: Genomic and in vitro characterization of two lytic bacteriophages infecting multidrug-resistant Erwinia sp.菌株AnSW2-5
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 多重耐药（MDR）欧文氏菌病原体对全球作物健康和农业可持续发展构成严重威胁。在这项研究中，我们鉴定了两种新型裂解性噬菌体：AnSW2-5-P-A（自写病毒科）和 AnSW2-5-P-K（Caudoviricetes 类），针对 MDR 欧文氏菌。菌株AnSW2-5。比较基因组学和 TEM 分析揭示了不同的病毒体结构，并确认了溶原相关基因的不存在，确保了它们作为生物防治剂的安全性。一步生长测定表明，P-A 具有较短的潜伏期（约 20 分钟），而 P-K 表现出明显更大的爆发大小（约 110 PFU/细胞）。在共培养测定中，双噬菌体混合物表现出深远的协同效应，实现了 > 80% 的细菌减少 (p < 0.05) 并维持对宿主的持续抑制达 72 小时。值得注意的是，该混合物有效地防止了耐药突变体的出现，将耐药频率（FoR）降低到检测限以下（< 10⁻⁸）。这些发现强调了使用具有互补裂解活性的遗传多样性噬菌体对作为针对 MDR 植物病原体的强大的、抗性抑制生物防治策略的潜力。

data.title: Seismic performance of reinforced concrete beam column joints strengthened with ECC shells
data.author: Ziwang Xiao, Lifeng Wang, Rikang Huang
data.summary: Reinforced concrete (RC) beam–column joints are vulnerable to brittle failure under seismic actions due to their limited deformation capacity, posing a threat to the overall safety of RC frames. To address this issue, this study proposes and evaluates a novel strengthening strategy for RC joints using an engineered cementitious composite (ECC) shell, forming a beam–column joint with an ECC shell (BCJES). The mechanical behavior of the BCJES under cyclic loading was investigated through a refined finite element (FE) model. The FE model, validated against test results, enabled a systematic parametric study to quantify the effects of ECC shell height and thickness, longitudinal reinforcement ratio (at the beam region), and axial compression ratio on seismic performance. Results demonstrate that the proposed ECC shell markedly enhances the seismic capacity of RC joints. Increasing the longitudinal reinforcement ratio from 0.05% to 0.2% improved peak load from 33.87 to 85.58 kN (152%), while increasing shell thickness from 30 to 90 mm enhanced peak load by 11.9%. However, a saturation effect was observed, as further thickening the shell to 150 mm resulted in only a 2.46% gain. Based on the parametric results, this study, for the first time, establishes a quantitative predictive model for the ultimate bearing capacity of BCJES using multiple linear regression (R²= 0.943). Furthermore, a new theoretical shear–capacity model incorporating both main and lateral diagonal bracing mechanisms is developed. Theoretical predictions agree well with FE simulations and experimental results, with maximum deviations of only 7.5% and 7.9%, respectively, confirming the reliability of the proposed approach. These findings highlight the potential of the ECC shell as an effective and practical seismic-strengthening solution for RC joints, offering new insights for performance-based design and retrofit strategies.
data.title_cn: 用ECC壳体加固的钢筋混凝土梁柱接头的抗震性能
data.abstract_cn: 钢筋混凝土梁柱节点由于变形能力有限，在地震作用下容易发生脆性破坏，对RC框架的整体安全构成威胁。为了解决这个问题，本研究提出并评估了一种使用工程水泥复合材料 (ECC) 壳的 RC 节点新型加固策略，形成带有 ECC 壳的梁柱节点 (BCJES)。通过精细的有限元 (FE) 模型研究了 BCJES 在循环载荷下的机械行为。有限元模型根据测试结果进行验证，可进行系统参数研究，以量化 ECC 壳体高度和厚度、纵向配筋率（梁区域）和轴压比对抗震性能的影响。结果表明，所提出的 ECC 壳体显着增强了 RC 节点的抗震能力。将纵向钢筋比例从 0.05% 增加到 0.2%，峰值载荷从 33.87 kN 提高到 85.58 kN (152%)，同时壳体厚度从 30 mm 增加到 90 mm，峰值载荷提高了 11.9%。然而，观察到饱和效应，进一步将壳加厚至 150 毫米仅导致 2.46% 的增益。基于参数化结果，本研究首次利用多元线性回归建立了BCJES极限承载力的定量预测模型（R²= 0.943）。此外，还开发了一种新的理论剪切能力模型，该模型结合了主斜支撑机构和侧斜支撑机构。理论预测与有限元模拟和实验结果吻合良好，最大偏差分别仅为 7.5% 和 7.9%，证实了该方法的可靠性。这些发现凸显了 ECC 壳体作为 RC 接头有效且实用的抗震加固解决方案的潜力，为基于性能的设计和改造策略提供了新的见解。

data.title: The evolution characteristics of leakage current in traction network surge arresters under complex operating conditions
data.author: Wang Pengxiong, Feng Lifeng, Gao Yongqiang, Tian Fuqiang
data.summary: Due to frequent load fluctuations, significant impacts, and substantial harmonic distortion on heavy-load railways, leakage currents monitored by surge arresters exhibit considerable variation. This leads to abnormal operations, causing changes in lightning counters and affecting maintenance scheduling for surge arresters. To effectively monitor the operational status of surge arresters on heavy-load railways, this paper analyzes their tripping characteristics under common operating conditions based on actual railway operations. A PSCAD-based simulation model for heavy-load railways was established, revealing that under harmonic overvoltage conditions, the effective tripping current of arresters farther from the load is significantly lower—often half or less than that of arresters closer to the load. The magnitude of leakage currents on both sides remains nearly constant regardless of train load position. When grid-side faults flow through traction transformers into the catenary system, short-circuit faults do not affect surge arrester leakage currents. However, open-circuit faults cause surge arrester operating currents to exhibit periodic currents near 20 Hz, with peak operating currents corresponding to overvoltage peaks. Operational overvoltage generates a short-duration operating current of approximately 1100µA, 2.5 times the normal operating level, lasting milliseconds. Lightning overvoltage operating characteristics resemble operational overvoltage but exhibit higher amplitudes and shorter durations. Furthermore, this paper analyzes the leakage current of surge arresters from mathematical, frequency, and power consumption perspectives to distinguish their operational states, thereby enhancing the accuracy and intelligence of online monitoring for surge arresters.
data.title_cn: 复杂运行工况下牵引网避雷器漏电流演化特性
data.abstract_cn: 由于重载铁路负荷波动频繁、影响大、谐波畸变大，避雷器监测的漏电流变化较大。这会导致操作异常，导致雷电计数器发生变化并影响避雷器的维护计划。为有效监测重载铁路避雷器的运行状态，结合铁路实际运行情况，分析避雷器常见运行工况下的跳闸特性。建立了基于PSCAD的重载铁路仿真模型，表明在谐波过电压条件下，远离负载的避雷器的有效跳闸电流明显较低，通常比靠近负载的避雷器有效跳闸电流低一半或更少。无论列车负载位置如何，两侧漏电流的大小几乎保持恒定。当网侧故障通过牵引变压器流入接触网系统时，短路故障不会影响避雷器漏电流。然而，开路故障会导致避雷器工作电流呈现出接近 20 Hz 的周期性电流，峰值工作电流对应于过压峰值。工作过压会产生约 1100μA 的短时工作电流，是正常工作水平的 2.5 倍，持续数毫秒。雷电过电压工作特性类似于操作过电压，但表现出更高的幅度和更短的持续时间。此外，本文从数学、频率、功耗等角度对避雷器漏电流进行分析，区分避雷器的运行状态，从而提高避雷器在线监测的准确性和智能性。

data.title: Scene-level passive polarization 3D imaging
data.author: Xin Wang, Pingli Han, Xiyuan Luo, Qianqian Liu, Tong Zhang, Xue Dong, Meng Xiang, Jinpeng Liu, Yanyan Liu, Fei Liu
data.summary: Scene-level passive 3D imaging under natural conditions is highly challenging yet urgently demanded. Polarization 3D provides possibility but impeded by two major obstacles brought by natural large scenes: discontinuities of multiple targets and dynamic reconstruction. This study proposed a scene-level passive polarization 3D imaging method, integrating binocular stereo and polarization. We abstract the discontinuous targets reconstruction into a minimization problem. The pixel-level normal direction from polarization and the absolute scale information from binocular stereo vision then work as mutual constraints for iterative optimization of the problem. By iterating for final solution, the challenge of reconstructing discontinuous targets was tackled, and true depth was also recovered. The true depth then provides a reference for solving inter-frame scale inconsistencies which hinders dynamic reconstruction by the designed scale normalization strategy which globally aligns multi-view measurement data. Scene-level 3D structure was finally reconstructed through multi-frame point cloud fusion. We showcase wide-scene, high-accuracy passive video reconstructions on natural field scenes. Our passive polarization stereo represents a major advancement in scene-level 3D imaging and may find broad applications in fields requiring passive 3D imaging solutions.
data.title_cn: 场景级被动偏振 3D 成像
data.abstract_cn: 自然条件下的场景级被动 3D 成像极具挑战性，但需求迫切。偏振3D提供了可能性，但受到自然大场景带来的两个主要障碍的阻碍：多目标的不连续性和动态重建。本研究提出了一种融合双目立体和偏振的场景级被动偏振3D成像方法。我们将不连续目标重构抽象为最小化问题。来自偏振的像素级法线方向和来自双目立体视觉的绝对尺度信息作为问题迭代优化的相互约束。通过迭代最终解决方案，解决了重建不连续目标的挑战，并且还恢复了真实深度。然后，通过设计全局对齐多视图测量数据的尺度归一化策略，真实深度为解决阻碍动态重建的帧间尺度不一致问题提供参考。最终通过多帧点云融合重建场景级3D结构。我们展示了自然场场景的宽场景、高精度被动视频重建。我们的被动偏振立体代表了场景级 3D 成像的重大进步，并且可能在需要被动 3D 成像解决方案的领域找到广泛的应用。

data.title: Modelling-guided inverse design strategy for semitransparent perovskite photovoltaics with customized colors
data.author: Seok-Beom Seo, Rira Kang, Eun-Joo Lee, So-Yeon Ju, Min Jae Lee, Byunghong Lee, Sun-Kyung Kim
data.summary: Urban architects increasingly seek solar windows that deliver both energy generation and aesthetic value. However, existing color-engineering strategies rely on absorptive metal layers or lack control over the achievable colors. Here, we present a modelling-guided inverse design strategy that integrates an all-dielectric (ZnS/MgF 2 ) multilayer into semitransparent perovskite photovoltaics, enabling user-defined colors with minimal spectral loss. Leveraging an active learning algorithm, we mapped the attainable color gamut for ZnS/MgF 2 -coated devices with distinct perovskite absorber thicknesses and average visible transmittance (AVT) values. As a representative case, a device with a 110 nm-thick absorber on glass or polyethylene terephthalate (PET), initially exhibiting a reddish-brown tint, was transformed into vivid cyan using a 600 nm-thick all-dielectric multilayer. This tuning retained high AVT—6.5% on glass and 5.3% on PET—while enhancing power conversion efficiency by 20.9% and 10.4%, respectively. Real-world imaging confirmed enhanced aesthetics with see-through visibility, underscoring the practical potential of the inverse-design framework. Moreover, this approach is readily transferable to other thin film photovoltaics, providing a versatile route toward color customizable, transmittance-tunable, and high-efficiency solar windows for buildings, vehicles, and wearable electronics.
data.title_cn: 具有定制颜色的半透明钙钛矿光伏电池的建模引导逆向设计策略
data.abstract_cn: 城市建筑师越来越多地寻求既能产生能源又具有审美价值的太阳能窗。然而，现有的色彩工程策略依赖于吸收金属层或缺乏对可实现颜色的控制。在这里，我们提出了一种建模引导的逆向设计策略，将全电介质 (ZnS/MgF 2 ) 多层集成到半透明钙钛矿光伏电池中，从而以最小的光谱损失实现用户定义的颜色。利用主动学习算法，我们绘制了具有不同钙钛矿吸收体厚度和平均可见光透射率 (AVT) 值的 ZnS/MgF 2 涂层器件可达到的色域。作为一个代表性案例，在玻璃或聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯 (PET) 上具有 110 nm 厚吸收剂的装置最初呈现红棕色色调，后来使用 600 nm 厚的全电介质多层转变为鲜艳的青色。这种调整保留了较高的 AVT（玻璃上为 6.5%，PET 上为 5.3%），同时功率转换效率分别提高了 20.9% 和 10.4%。现实世界的成像证实了透明可见性增强的美感，强调了逆向设计框架的实际潜力。此外，这种方法很容易转移到其他薄膜光伏器件，为建筑物、车辆和可穿戴电子产品提供颜色可定制、透射率可调和高效太阳能窗的通用途径。
