data.title: ESRGAN-LS: super-resolution reconstruction of multi-scale defects in aerospace thermal barrier coatings via attention enhancement and dynamic feature optimization
data.author: Cong Huang, Xing Peng, Feng Shi, Song Ci, Hongbing Cao, Xinjie Zhao
data.summary: Performance breakthroughs and safety assurance in flight equipment remain pivotal drivers of technological advancement, with every smooth flight relying on the stable output of core propulsion systems and the reliable operation of critical components. As the key protective system for hot-end components in aeroengines, thermal barrier coatings (TBCs) are prone to multi-scale defects under extremely high-temperature and high-pressure operating conditions. These defects severely compromise the reliability and lifespan of hot-end components, thereby impacting flight safety. Addressing the limitations of existing X-ray and infrared thermal imaging technologies in resolution, as well as the high cost and low efficiency of scanning electron microscopy, this study proposes ESRGAN-LS—an enhanced generative adversarial network-based super-resolution reconstruction method for multi-scale defects in TBCs. The model incorporates the CL-SE attention mechanism to introduce the improved dense residual block RRDB-LS, enhancing local feature perception and reconstruction capabilities for multi-scale defects. While preserving the core framework, an additional RRDB layer is added, and the final eight RRDB layers are replaced with the enhanced dense residual block RRDB-LS module. This achieves shallow-layer preservation of fundamental texture reconstruction while comprehensively capturing multiscale features in images or data through the enhanced effect of local defect detection in the latter eight layers, enabling dynamic optimization of feature channels. Using the DIV2K dataset as the training set, experimental results demonstrate that, compared to the ESRGAN generator model, the ESRGAN-LS generator model achieves a 0.3% and 0.12% improvement in PSNR and SSIM metrics, respectively, on the Urban dataset. And on the Manga109 dataset, PSNR and SSIM improved by 0.35% and 0.1%, respectively. This significantly enhances visual discernibility and texture detail in defect regions, effectively preserving critical information at defect locations and markedly improving denoising performance after reconstruction. Two defect characterization experiments were conducted: defect ROI feature extraction and 3D visualization of defect features. Focusing on defect edge contours, these experiments significantly advance the intelligent recognition of multi-scale defects. The results validate the method’s effectiveness in quantitative defect characterization and intelligent detection, concluding that the improved model designed in this study demonstrates superior reconstruction capabilities for texture details and edge information in multi-scale defects of aeroengine thermal barrier coatings. This research provides efficient technical support for ensuring engine safety and extending operational lifespan, holding significant implications for achieving high-precision visual inspection solutions in the high-end equipment manufacturing industry.
data.title_cn: ESRGAN-LS：通过注意力增强和动态特征优化对航空航天热障涂层中的多尺度缺陷进行超分辨率重建
data.abstract_cn: 飞行装备的性能突破和安全保障仍然是技术进步的关键驱动力，每一次顺利飞行都依赖于核心推进系统的稳定输出和关键部件的可靠运行。热障涂层（TBC）作为航空发动机热端部件的关键保护系统，在极高温度和高压的工作条件下容易出现多尺度缺陷。这些缺陷严重影响热端部件的可靠性和使用寿命，从而影响飞行安全。针对现有X射线和红外热成像技术在分辨率方面的局限性，以及扫描电子显微镜成本高、效率低的问题，本研究提出了ESRGAN-LS——一种基于增强型生成对抗网络的热障涂层多尺度缺陷超分辨率重建方法。该模型结合了CL-SE注意力机制，引入改进的密集残差块RRDB-LS，增强了对多尺度缺陷的局部特征感知和重建能力。在保留核心框架的同时，添加了一个额外的 RRDB 层，最后八个 RRDB 层被增强的密集残差块 RRDB-LS 模块替换。这实现了基本纹理重建的浅层保留，同时通过后八层局部缺陷检测的增强效果全面捕获图像或数据中的多尺度特征，从而实现特征通道的动态优化。使用 DIV2K 数据集作为训练集，实验结果表明，与 ESRGAN 生成器模型相比，ESRGAN-LS 生成器模型在 Urban 数据集上的 PSNR 和 SSIM 指标分别实现了 0.3% 和 0.12% 的改进。在 Manga109 数据集上，PSNR 和 SSIM 分别提高了 0.35% 和 0.1%。这显着增强了缺陷区域的视觉辨别力和纹理细节，有效保留了缺陷位置的关键信息，并显着提高了重建后的去噪性能。进行了两个缺陷表征实验：缺陷ROI特征提取和缺陷特征的3D可视化。这些实验以缺陷边缘轮廓为重点，显着推进了多尺度缺陷的智能识别。结果验证了该方法在定量缺陷表征和智能检测方面的有效性，得出结论：本研究设计的改进模型表现出对航空发动机热障涂层多尺度缺陷纹理细节和边缘信息的优越重建能力。该研究为保障发动机安全、延长使用寿命提供了高效的技术支撑，对高端装备制造业实现高精度视觉检测解决方案具有重要意义。

data.title: Simons Observatory: on-sky performance of radio-transparent multi-layer insulation using Styroace-II styrofoam
data.author: Samuel Day-Weiss, Nicholas Galitzki, Atsuto Takeuchi, Kam Arnold, Kathleen Harrington, Masaya Hasegawa, Bradley R. Johnson, Akito Kusaka, Aashrita Mangu, Jack Orlowski-Scherer, Lyman A. Page, Yoshinori Sueno, Osamu Tajima, Alex Thomas, Yuhan Wang, Edward J. Wollack, Kyohei Yamada
data.summary: We present the on-sky performance of a radio-transparent multi-layer insulation filter (RT-MLI) that uses Styroace-II styrofoam to reject ambient thermal radiation from entering a 0.42 m diameter aperture to a sub-100 mK bolometric detector array cooled by a dilution refrigerator. We find that greater than 90% of the expected incident infra-red (IR) radiation is rejected, resulting in <12W of measured transmitted power. Transmitted power in the detector passbands is consistent with a lower bound of 95%. We address filter design and placement, thermal loading, and mm-wave transmission.
data.title_cn: 西蒙斯天文台：使用 Styroace-II 聚苯乙烯泡沫塑料实现无线电透明多层绝缘体的空中性能
data.abstract_cn: 我们展示了无线电透明多层绝缘滤波器 (RT-MLI) 的空中性能，该滤波器使用 Styroace-II 聚苯乙烯泡沫塑料来阻止环境热辐射进入 0.42 m 直径孔径，到达由稀释制冷机冷却的低于 100 mK 的辐射热探测器阵列。我们发现超过 90% 的预期入射红外 (IR) 辐射被拒绝，导致测得的发射功率 <12W。检测器通带中的发射功率与 95% 的下限一致。我们解决滤波器设计和放置、热负载和毫米波传输问题。

data.title: Plasmonic electro-optic modulators integrated with a silicon rib waveguide
data.author: Masoud Shabaninezhad, Hamid Mehrvar, Eric Bernier, Lora Ramunno, Pierre Berini
data.summary: We propose, model, and design plasmonic electro-optic modulators integrated with a silicon-on-insulator (SOI) rib waveguide. The devices are based on a pair of metal-insulator-semiconductor-metal (MISM) stacks operating as metal-oxide-semiconductor (MOS) capacitors proximity-coupled laterally to the SOI rib. The SOI rib is tapered laterally to adiabatically evolve the TM 0 mode therein into a coupled mode exhibiting field enhancement and strong localization to the MISM stacks. The semiconductor used in the MISM stacks consists of a thin highly doped indium tin oxide (ITO) layer to enable a low drive voltage followed by a thicker and lower doped ITO layer to reduce the on-state loss. The ITO is driven into accumulation, such that epsilon-near-zero is reached, which further enhances the fields in the MISM stacks and induces high loss in the off-state via the carrier refraction effect. An example design, 3.75 µm long including input and output tapers, yields an on-state insertion loss of 5.8 dB, an extinction ratio of 5 dB, and an RC-limited electrical bandwidth of 214 GHz.
data.title_cn: 与硅肋波导集成的等离子体电光调制器
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出、建模和设计与绝缘体上硅 (SOI) 肋形波导集成的等离子体电光调制器。该器件基于一对金属-绝缘体-半导体-金属 (MISM) 堆栈，用作横向邻近耦合到 SOI 肋的金属-氧化物-半导体 (MOS) 电容器。 SOI肋横向逐渐变细，以将其中的TM 0 模式绝热演化为耦合模式，表现出场增强和对MISM叠层的强局域化。 MISM 堆栈中使用的半导体由薄的高掺杂氧化铟锡 (ITO) 层组成，以实现低驱动电压，随后是较厚且低掺杂的 ITO 层，以减少通态损耗。 ITO 被驱动累积，从而达到接近零的 epsilon，这进一步增强了 MISM 堆栈中的场，并通过载流子折射效应在关断状态下引起高损耗。示例设计长度为 3.75 µm，包括输入和输出锥度，通态插入损耗为 5.8 dB，消光比为 5 dB，RC 限制电带宽为 214 GHz。

data.title: Low-coherence digital holographic microscope with a Fizeau interferometer
data.author: Mohit Rathor, Shivam Kumar Chaubey, Neha Choudhary, Rakesh Kumar Singh
data.summary: We present a digital holographic microscope (DHM) for speckle-free quantitative imaging and depth sectioning. The proposed DHM employs an incoherent light source in an in-line Fizeau interferometer configuration with a tunable longitudinal separation between the interfering beams. This configuration enables recording fringes within the source’s longitudinal coherence length, facilitating depth-sectioning capability and quantitative imaging. A polarization-phase shifting approach retrieves a quantitative speckle-free phase image from experimentally recorded interferograms. Experimental validation using smooth and rough objects demonstrates the system’s performance, further supported by the perception-based image quality evaluator. The proposed DHM shows promising applications in pathological, material science, and metrology.
data.title_cn: 配备斐索干涉仪的低相干数字全息显微镜
data.abstract_cn: 我们推出了一种用于无散斑定量成像和深度切片的数字全息显微镜 (DHM)。所提出的 DHM 采用在线斐索干涉仪配置中的非相干光源，干涉光束之间的纵向间隔可调。这种配置能够在源的纵向相干长度内记录条纹，从而促进深度切片能力和定量成像。偏振相移方法从实验记录的干涉图中检索定量的无散斑相位图像。使用光滑和粗糙物体的实验验证展示了系统的性能，并得到基于感知的图像质量评估器的进一步支持。所提出的 DHM 在病理学、材料科学和计量学方面显示出有前景的应用。

data.title: Non-critical phase matching KTiOAsO 4 optical parametric oscillator with a RISTRA cavity at 300 Hz
data.author: Tao Li, Jun Meng, Gaoyou Liu, Zhaojun Liu
data.summary: In this paper, we report a rotated image singly-resonant twisted rectangular (RISTRA) resonator implemented in a non-critical phase-matching (NCPM) KTiOAsO 4 (KTA) optical parametric oscillator (OPO). Unlike previous studies mainly focused on critically phase-matched configurations with significant spatial walk-off, this work demonstrates that the RISTRA cavity can still enhance beam quality when walk-off is negligible. The resonator introduces a 90° image rotation per round trip, which suppresses the excitation of higher order transverse modes and thus improves mode discrimination. The RISTRA cavity produces 50.3 mJ of signal and 15.5 mJ of idler energy, comparable to the planar ring cavity output of 54.0 mJ (signal) and 18.2 mJ (idler). However, the beam quality is improved: the signal M 2 is improved from 4.7×4.4 in the planar ring cavity to 2.9×2.8 in the RISTRA cavity, and the idler M 2 improves from 4.7×6.4 to 2.5×2.5. These results confirm that RISTRA remains effective for beam-quality enhancement in NCPM OPOs.
data.title_cn: 非临界相位匹配 KTiOAsO 4 光学参量振荡器，带 RISTRA 腔，频率为 300 Hz
data.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们报告了在非临界相位匹配（NCPM）KTiOAsO 4 （KTA）光学参量振荡器（OPO）中实现的旋转图像单谐振扭曲矩形（RISTRA）谐振器。与之前的研究主要集中在具有显着空间走离的临界相位匹配配置不同，这项工作表明，当走离可以忽略不计时，RISTRA 腔仍然可以提高光束质量。谐振器每次往返都会引入 90° 图像旋转，从而抑制高阶横向模式的激励，从而提高模式辨别力。 RISTRA 腔产生 50.3 mJ 信号和 15.5 mJ 闲频能量，与 54.0 mJ（信号）和 18.2 mJ（闲频）的平面环形腔输出相当。但光束质量得到改善：信号M 2 从平面环腔中的4.7×4.4提高到RISTRA腔中的2.9×2.8，惰轮M 2 从4.7×6.4提高到2.5×2.5。这些结果证实 RISTRA 对于 NCPM OPO 中的光束质量增强仍然有效。

data.title: Diode-assisted microheaters for programmable photonic integrated circuits
data.author: Kumar Piyush, Pawan Kumar Pandit, Ashitosh Velamuri, Arnab Goswami, Janakiraman Viraraghavan, Bijoy Krishna Das
data.summary: Thermo-optically tunable Mach–Zehnder interferometer (MZI) switches have been popular for building robust designs of programmable photonic integrated circuits (PPICs) for various applications. In general, microheaters integrated on both arms of the MZIs are preferred to minimize power consumption by accounting for phase errors between MZI arms arising from fabrication-induced process variabilities. However, only one of the two microheaters integrated in MZI arms is chosen to drive, for achieving desired phase imbalance with lower power consumption. Again, integrating microheaters on both arms doubles the electronic control channels and as many bond pads, posing challenges for scalability and packaging. To address this, we propose a diode-assisted microheater (DAM) architecture that enables selective driving of one of the two microheaters in an MZI without increasing the pad count or control complexity. The DAM is implemented on a standard silicon photonics technology platform and is fully compatible with foundry processes. Comprehensive electrothermal simulations and subsequent experimental results confirm the CMOS foundry fabrication feasibility of such diode-assisted microheater designs. The integrated diode design exhibits low series resistance and high breakdown voltage, ensuring efficient forward operation and negligible reverse leakage. Both the diode and microheater resistances were modelled as functions of the forward current, showing excellent agreement with experimental data. DC and AC characterizations reveal that the DAM achieves efficient thermal tuning with a total power dissipation of ∼50 mW at ±3 V and a rise/fall time of ∼20 μ s. The DAM’s performance was validated in a 1 × 4 power splitter comprising cascaded 1 × 2 MZIs, fabricated through a commercial silicon photonics foundry. Using DAM-based tuning, we achieved precise phase correction, yielding uniform power splitting with deviations of only ±0.015 dB at 1550 nm and ±0.025 dB across a 40 nm operating wavelength bandwidth. Furthermore, by employing bipolar driving and selectively activating one of the MZI arms, we experimentally demonstrated a reduction in power consumption exceeding 50% when compared with the experimental results for the same PPIC by assuming only one microheater was integrated in MZIs. These results demonstrate that the proposed DAM architecture offers a scalable, power-efficient, and foundry-compatible solution for next-generation PPICs.
data.title_cn: 用于可编程光子集成电路的二极管辅助微加热器
data.abstract_cn: 热光可调谐马赫-曾德尔干涉仪 (MZI) 开关在为各种应用构建稳健的可编程光子集成电路 (PPIC) 设计方面广受欢迎。一般来说，最好在 MZI 的两个臂上集成微型加热器，以通过考虑由制造引起的工艺变化引起的 MZI 臂之间的相位误差来最小化功耗。然而，仅选择集成在 MZI 臂中的两个微加热器之一进行驱动，以较低的功耗实现所需的相位不平衡。同样，在双臂上集成微型加热器使电子控制通道和焊盘数量加倍，这对可扩展性和封装提出了挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种二极管辅助微加热器 (DAM) 架构，可以选择性驱动 MZI 中的两个微加热器之一，而无需增加焊盘数量或控制复杂性。 DAM 在标准硅光子技术平台上实现，与代工工艺完全兼容。全面的电热模拟和随后的实验结果证实了这种二极管辅助微加热器设计的 CMOS 代工制造可行性。集成二极管设计具有低串联电阻和高击穿电压，确保高效的正向操作和可忽略的反向泄漏。二极管和微型加热器电阻都被建模为正向电流的函数，与实验数据表现出极好的一致性。直流和交流特性表明，DAM 实现了高效的热调谐，±3 V 时的总功耗约为 50 mW，上升/下降时间约为 20 μs。 DAM 的性能在由级联 1 × 2 MZI 组成的 1 × 4 功率分配器中得到验证，该功率分配器由商业硅光子代工厂制造。使用基于 DAM 的调谐，我们实现了精确的相位校正，产生均匀的功率分配，在 1550 nm 处偏差仅为 ±0.015 dB，在 40 nm 工作波长带宽上偏差仅为 ±0.025 dB。此外，通过采用双极驱动并选择性地激活其中一个 MZI 臂，我们通过实验证明，与假设 MZI 中仅集成一个微加热器的相同 PPIC 的实验结果相比，功耗降低了 50% 以上。这些结果表明，所提出的 DAM 架构为下一代 PPIC 提供了可扩展、节能且兼容代工厂的解决方案。

data.title: Sub-wavelength grating silicon to silicon nitride interlayer couplers in commercial foundry silicon photonics
data.author: Uthkarsh Adya, Sajjad Moazeni
data.summary: The development of silicon photonics platforms has played a pivotal role in enabling large-scale photonic integrated circuits (PICs). Most of today’s silicon photonics processes incorporate silicon nitride to realize devices requiring ultra-low loss and to leverage its unique material properties. Efficient light transport between the silicon and silicon nitride layers necessitates a compact and high-performance interlayer coupler. In this work, we utilize the tunable refractive index and dispersion properties of subwavelength grating (SWG) waveguides in the silicon layer to design compact and broadband interlayer couplers. We present analytical modeling, supported by simulations, of interlayer coupling and experimentally demonstrate proof-of-concept interlayer transitions using the GlobalFoundries 45SPCLO process.
data.title_cn: 商业铸造硅光子学中的亚波长光栅硅到氮化硅层间耦合器
data.abstract_cn: 硅光子平台的发展在实现大规模光子集成电路（PIC）方面发挥了关键作用。当今大多数硅光子工艺都采用氮化硅来实现需要超低损耗的设备并利用其独特的材料特性。硅层和氮化硅层之间的高效光传输需要紧凑且高性能的层间耦合器。在这项工作中，我们利用硅层中亚波长光栅（SWG）波导的可调折射率和色散特性来设计紧凑的宽带层间耦合器。我们提出了层间耦合的分析模型（由仿真支持），并使用 GlobalFoundries 45SPCLO 流程通过实验演示了概念验证的层间转换。

data.title: Optimization of wavefront measurement method for polarization modulators
data.author: Yang Jing-Jie, Hou Jun-Feng, Gao Bi-Yuan, Shen Yu-Liang, Wang Zhe-Kai
data.summary: Polarization modulators are core components in polarimetric imaging, and measuring their wavefront aberration is a prerequisite for achieving high-resolution polarimetric imaging observations. However, when using a Fizeau interferometer for measuring the wavefront aberration of a polarization modulator, the polarization modulator under test may significantly affect the contrast of interference fringes due to additional polarization effects, thereby degrading the accuracy of wavefront aberration measurement. In this study, a polarization model for the Fizeau interferometer—tailored for wavefront testing of polarization-sensitive components—was developed, and its measurement limitations were systematically analyzed. An optimization method employing a standard quarter-wave plate is presented, which improves fringe contrast compared to traditional interferometric configurations, and its efficacy is experimentally verified. Results demonstrate that this method enables accurate wavefront measurement of Stokes parameter-based polarization modulators under arbitrary configurations. Furthermore, the approach can be extended to general polarization optical components and systems, thereby broadening the applicability of Fizeau laser interferometers in polarization-sensitive optical systems and improving both the versatility and accuracy of measurements.
data.title_cn: 偏振调制器波前测量方法的优化
data.abstract_cn: 偏振调制器是偏振成像的核心部件，测量其波前像差是实现高分辨率偏振成像观测的先决条件。然而，当使用斐索干涉仪测量偏振调制器的波前像差时，被测偏振调制器可能会因附加偏振效应而显着影响干涉条纹的对比度，从而降低波前像差测量的精度。在这项研究中，开发了斐索干涉仪的偏振模型（专为偏振敏感元件的波前测试而设计），并系统分析了其测量局限性。提出了一种采用标准四分之一波片的优化方法，与传统的干涉配置相比，该方法提高了条纹对比度，并通过实验验证了其有效性。结果表明，该方法能够在任意配置下精确测量基于斯托克斯参数的偏振调制器的波前。此外，该方法可以扩展到通用偏振光学元件和系统，从而拓宽了斐索激光干涉仪在偏振敏感光学系统中的适用性，提高了测量的通用性和准确性。

data.title: Phase-locked high-peak-power sub-ns laser for electron modulation in quasi-steady-state microbunching
data.author: Zhou Yang, Tianyi Tan, Xinyi Lu, Xing Liu, Zhong Chen, Qili Tian, Yan Zhao, Yutong Huang, Chao Li, Zhihua Huang, Xiujie Deng, Wenhui Huang, Chuanxiang Tang, Lixin Yan
data.summary: Steady-state microbunching (SSMB) represents an innovative light source concept capable of generating high-average-power, short-wavelength coherent radiation. To experimentally validate the quasi-SSMB, a turn-by-turn coherent modulation on electron bunches in a storage ring is critical. For this purpose, a dedicated phase-locked pulse laser system with high peak power and high repetition rate has been developed. Utilizing continuous-wave (CW) seed laser electro-optic gating in combination with a master oscillator power amplifier (MOPA) architecture, the laser system produces 1064 nm laser pulses with a pulse width of 0.5 ns, a repetition rate of 6.25 MHz, and a peak power of 32 kW. Based on an iodine frequency-stabilized CW seed laser as the frequency reference, an optical phase-locked loop (OPLL) achieves phase locking of the output pulse laser. Beat signal measurements demonstrate significant phase noise suppression in the 10 Hz–10 kHz range. This work proposes a method for achieving laser-based coherent modulation on electron bunch trains and demonstrates a versatile design scheme capable of generating phase-locked laser pulses with high repetition rate and high peak power.
data.title_cn: 用于准稳态微聚束电子调制的锁相高峰值功率亚纳秒激光器
data.abstract_cn: 稳态微聚束 (SSMB) 代表了一种创新光源概念，能够产生高平均功率、短波长相干辐射。为了通过实验验证准 SSMB，对存储环中的电子束进行逐轮相干调制至关重要。为此，开发了具有高峰值功率和高重复率的专用锁相脉冲激光系统。该激光系统利用连续波 (CW) 种子激光电光选通与主振荡器功率放大器 (MOPA) 架构相结合，产生 1064 nm 激光脉冲，脉冲宽度为 0.5 ns，重复率为 6.25 MHz，峰值功率为 32 kW。以碘稳频连续种子激光器为频率基准，利用光学锁相环（OPLL）实现输出脉冲激光的锁相。拍频信号测量显示 10 Hz–10 kHz 范围内具有显着的相位噪声抑制。这项工作提出了一种在电子束串上实现基于激光的相干调制的方法，并展示了一种能够生成具有高重复率和高峰值功率的锁相激光脉冲的通用设计方案。

data.title: High-performance dual-band silicon slow-light modulator for DWDM chip-scale applications
data.author: Zanyun Zhang, Hao Jiang, Meixin Li, Qixin Wang, Wenjing Zhang, Xiaoqing Lv, Kaixin Zhang, Tianjun Liu, Beiju Huang
data.summary: This paper presents a silicon slow-light modulator based on cascaded phase-shifted Bragg grating (PSBG) structures, which supports C/L dual-band modulation and demonstrates consistent wavelength channel performance across these bands. The modulator has an ultra-compact modulation length of only 201 µm, a normalized insertion loss of 5.3 dB, an electro-optic bandwidth of up to 85 GHz, and an OOK modulation speed of up to 128 Gbaud. Notably, it features a breakthrough in operational bandwidth, with a flat passband exceeding 20 nm in both C and L bands, and achieves an energy efficiency of 0.242 pJ/bit. The design integrates CMOS compatibility, small footprint, low insertion loss, high bandwidth, and extensive working wavelength range, providing an efficient solution for high-density wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) chip-scale interconnects.
data.title_cn: 适用于 DWDM 芯片级应用的高性能双频硅慢光调制器
data.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种基于级联相移布拉格光栅（PSBG）结构的硅慢光调制器，它支持C/L双波段调制，并在这些波段上表现出一致的波长通道性能。该调制器的超紧凑调制长度仅为 201 µm，归一化插入损耗为 5.3 dB，电光带宽高达 85 GHz，OOK 调制速度高达 128 Gbaud。值得注意的是，它在工作带宽方面取得了突破，C和L波段的平坦通带均超过20 nm，能效达到0.242 pJ/bit。该设计集成了 CMOS 兼容性、小尺寸、低插入损耗、高带宽和广泛的工作波长范围，为高密度波分复用 (DWDM) 芯片级互连提供了高效的解决方案。

data.title: Synchronous single-photon LiDAR ranging with up to two triggers per pulse cycle
data.author: Xiaofang Wang, Yan Kang, Tongyi Zhang, Lifei Li, Wei Kang, Wei Zhao
data.summary: Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD)-based light detection and ranging (LiDAR) introduces significant pileup errors at high echo photon flux due to the SPAD’s dead time. To expand the application of single-photon LiDAR in the field of remote sensing, autonomous driving, etc., it is crucial to perform rapid and accurate ranging within an echo photon flux of a wide dynamic range. Emerging SPAD array detectors combined with specific photon detection modes attempt to strike a balance between photon detection efficiency and hardware resources, necessitating the development of appropriate dead time compensation methods. Therefore, we experimentally investigated a synchronous single-photon ranging LiDAR operating in a mode where up to two photons are detected per laser cycle, and proposed dead time compensation methods based on forward modeling of the photon detection process. The results show that, using a wide laser pulse of 3.5 ns, the compensated ranging error is less than 4.2 cm, while the uncompensated ranging error is as max as 17.96 cm. Our method provides a reference for dead time compensation in single-photon LiDAR that requires comprehensive consideration of detection efficiency and hardware resources.
data.title_cn: 每个脉冲周期最多有两个触发器的同步单光子 LiDAR 测距
data.abstract_cn: 基于单光子雪崩二极管 (SPAD) 的光探测和测距 (LiDAR) 由于 SPAD 的死区时间，在高回波光子通量时会引入严重的堆积误差。为了拓展单光子激光雷达在遥感、自动驾驶等领域的应用，在宽动态范围的回波光子通量内进行快速、准确的测距至关重要。新兴的SPAD阵列探测器结合特定的光子探测模式试图在光子探测效率和硬件资源之间取得平衡，因此需要开发适当的死区时间补偿方法。因此，我们通过实验研究了同步单光子测距激光雷达，其工作模式为每个激光周期最多检测两个光子，并提出了基于光子检测过程正向建模的死区时间补偿方法。结果表明，采用3.5 ns的宽激光脉冲，补偿后的测距误差小于4.2 cm，而未补偿的测距误差最大为17.96 cm。我们的方法为需要综合考虑检测效率和硬件资源的单光子激光雷达死区时间补偿提供了参考。

data.title: See-through aerial imaging display with eyebox control optical system
data.author: Naru Usukura, Shiro Suyama, Hirotsugu Yamamoto
data.summary: We propose what we believe to be a novel non-mechanical eyebox (EB) control optical system for aerial imaging by retro-reflection (AIRR) integrated with virtual reality (VR) head-mounted display (HMD) optics, eliminating the need for the user to wear an HMD. This technology enhances the user’s positional freedom. To demonstrate the concept, we employ a Pancharatnam Berry phase diffraction grating (PBP-DG) as a one-dimensional (1D) EB position-shifting device and fabricate a demonstrator. Experimental results confirm that the demonstrator successfully shifts the EB approximately 8 mm in the horizontal direction using a PBP-DG located 30 mm away from the VR HMD optics. Furthermore, we confirm that the virtual image distance can be varied depending on the distance between the display and the VR HMD optics.
data.title_cn: 具有眼箱控制光学系统的透视航空成像显示器
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新型非机械眼箱 (EB) 控制光学系统，用于通过逆反射 (AIRR) 进行航空成像，并与虚拟现实 (VR) 头戴式显示器 (HMD) 光学器件集成，从而消除了用户佩戴 HMD 的需要。该技术增强了用户的位置自由度。为了演示这一概念，我们采用 Pancharatnam Berry 相位衍射光栅 (PBP-DG) 作为一维 (1D) EB 位移装置并制造了一个演示器。实验结果证实，演示器使用距离 VR HMD 光学器件 30 毫米的 PBP-DG 成功地将 EB 在水平方向上移动了约 8 毫米。此外，我们确认虚像距离可以根据显示器和 VR HMD 光学器件之间的距离而变化。

data.title: Fast and sensitive wavelength modulation gas spectroscopy in micro-drilled hollow-core fiber
data.author: Eleanor A. Warrington, Robert Peverall, Patrick S. Salter, Gus Hancock, Martin J. Booth, Grant A. D. Ritchie, Julian A. J. Fells
data.summary: Micro-drilled anti-resonant fiber is demonstrated as a practicable tool for laser-based spectroscopic acetylene sensing, overcoming the slow fiber-filling time usually associated with hollow-core fiber-based methods. Microchannels were drilled through the side of the fiber, periodically along its length, using image processing to accurately target the gap between the capillaries for minimal loss. A 0.3% acetylene / 0.3% methane gas mixture balanced in air was tested in the near-infrared on two micro-machined fiber samples. Wavelength modulation spectroscopy was used to enhance the sensitivity of the detection. A 1 m anti-resonant fiber with microchannels every 5 cm was found to have a minimum detection limit of 380 parts per billion at atmospheric pressure and 100 s acquisition time with a 22 s fiber filling time without the use of a pressure differential. The filling time was 4.2 s for a 30 cm fiber with a closer microchannel separation of 2 cm.
data.title_cn: 微钻孔空心光纤中快速灵敏的波长调制气体光谱
data.abstract_cn: 微钻孔反谐振光纤被证明是基于激光的光谱乙炔传感的实用工具，克服了通常与基于空心光纤的方法相关的缓慢的光纤填充时间。沿着纤维的长度定期在纤维的侧面钻出微通道，利用图像处理准确瞄准毛细管之间的间隙，以最大限度地减少损失。在空气中平衡的 0.3% 乙炔/0.3% 甲烷气体混合物在两个微加工纤维样品上进行了近红外测试。使用波长调制光谱来提高检测的灵敏度。研究发现，每 5 cm 具有微通道的 1 m 反谐振光纤在大气压下的最小检测限为 380 ppb，采集时间为 100 s，光纤填充时间为 22 s，无需使用压差。对于 30 厘米纤维，微通道间隔更近 2 厘米，填充时间为 4.2 秒。

data.title: Spatiotemporally decoupled iterative algorithm using multi-order Taylor expansion for random phase-shifting interferometry with finite bandwidth illumination
data.author: Xiangxue Wang, Mingliang Duan, Zhihao Liu, Yuxuan Kan, Mengjiao Huang, Yafei Wang, Yi Zong, Jianxin Li
data.summary: Phase-shifting interferometry with finite bandwidth light sources is a key technique for high-precision measurement of ultra-smooth optical components. However, influenced by vibrations, moving devices, and spectral bandwidth, the interference fringes exhibit not only random phase-shifting errors but also intra- and inter-frame nonlinear and non-uniform variations in modulation amplitude, which degrades the phase retrieval accuracy of existing random phase-shifting algorithms. To solve this problem, we propose a spatiotemporally decoupled iterative algorithm (SDIA). This method decouples the spatiotemporally varying modulation amplitude via multi-order Taylor expansion, stepwise separating the time-dependent and space-dependent variables in two distinct iterative steps to construct linear equations without variable coupling, thereby achieving high-precision phase retrieval via the least-squares alternating iteration. Simulations and experiments validated the feasibility and high accuracy of the proposed algorithm. The experimental results demonstrate that, for randomly phase-shifted interferograms under 40 nm bandwidth illumination, the retrieval residual errors of a planar smooth mirror are below 1 nm (PV) and 0.1 nm (RMS), respectively. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that such a spatiotemporal decoupling iterative algorithm using multi-order Taylor expansion has been proposed, which can address both random phase-shifting errors and spatiotemporally coupled modulation variations under finite bandwidth illumination conditions.
data.title_cn: 使用多阶泰勒展开的时空解耦迭代算法用于有限带宽照明的随机相移干涉测量
data.abstract_cn: 有限带宽光源相移干涉测量是超光滑光学元件高精度测量的关键技术。然而，受振动、移动设备和光谱带宽的影响，干涉条纹不仅表现出随机相移误差，而且还表现出帧内和帧间调制幅度的非线性和不均匀变化，这降低了现有随机相移算法的相位恢复精度。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种时空解耦迭代算法（SDIA）。该方法通过多阶泰勒展开解耦时空变化的调制幅度，在两个不同的迭代步骤中逐步分离时间相关变量和空间相关变量，构建无变量耦合的线性方程，从而通过最小二乘交替迭代实现高精度相位恢复。仿真和实验验证了该算法的可行性和高精度。实验结果表明，对于40 nm带宽照明下的随机相移干涉图，平面光滑镜的反演残余误差分别低于1 nm（PV）和0.1 nm（RMS）。据我们所知，这是首次提出这种使用多阶泰勒展开的时空解耦迭代算法，该算法可以解决有限带宽照明条件下的随机相移误差和时空耦合调制变化。

data.title: Compressive dual-comb spectroscopy in the long-wave infrared region
data.author: Zhenhai Wang, Syed Tajammul Ahmad, Luca Moretti, Davide Gatti, Marco Marangoni, Aamir Farooq
data.summary: We present a compressive sensing framework for long-wave infrared dual-comb spectroscopy over 7.5–11.5 μm, enabling accurate spectral reconstruction from undersampled interferograms. For single-species N 2 O detection, spectral fidelity is preserved up to a compression factor of 20, with L 2 norm residuals below 1.3 × 10 −4 . The retrieved N 2 O concentrations maintain over 90% accuracy for compression factors up to 30. In the mixtures of CH 4 , N 2 O, and C 2 H 4 , all species are retrieved within 10% relative deviation up to a compression factor of 50. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework enables scalable, computationally efficient deployment of practical DCS systems for real-time trace gas sensing in resource-limited measurement scenarios.
data.title_cn: 长波红外区压缩双梳光谱
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种适用于 7.5–11.5 μm 范围内的长波红外双梳光谱的压缩传感框架，能够从欠采样干涉图进行精确的光谱重建。对于单物质 N 2 O 检测，压缩因子高达 20 时光谱保真度得以保留，L 2 范数残差低于 1.3 × 10 -4 。检索到的 N 2 O 浓度在压缩因子高达 30 的情况下保持超过 90% 的精度。在 CH 4 、N 2 O 和 C 2 H 4 的混合物中，在压缩因子高达 50 的情况下，所有组分的检索误差都在 10% 的相对偏差内。这些结果表明，所提出的框架能够在资源有限的测量场景中实现可扩展、计算高效的实际 DCS 系统部署，用于实时痕量气体传感。

data.title: High efficiency, widely tunable, green-laser-pumped BiB 3 O 6 femtosecond OPO with noncollinear phase matching in the yz plane
data.author: Heng Jing, Xiaoyang Zhou, Zhenhua Cong, Zhaojun Liu, Zhigang Zhao
data.summary: A femtosecond optical parametric oscillator (fs-OPO) based on type-I (o→e + e) noncollinear phase matching in the yz plane of bismuth triborate (BIBO) crystal is demonstrated, which breaks the bandwidth (700–1900 nm) limit set by collinear phase matching. The pumping source is provided by the second-harmonic (SH, 520 nm) wave of a homemade 1040-nm Yb:fiber femtosecond laser with a pulse duration of 177 fs and a repetition rate of 100 MHz. Experimentally, the wavelengths can be tuned from 626 nm to 3051 nm (626–1026 nm for signal and 1067–3051 nm for idler) by adjusting the angle of the BIBO crystal, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the widest wavelength tuning range for any BIBO-based femtosecond OPO. At the wavelength of 713 nm, the highest average power of 1.3 W is obtained, with a conversion efficiency of 37.1%. If both signal and idler powers are counted in, the total efficiency is 52%, which is a new benchmark. In addition, the compressed pulse duration is measured to be 108 fs at 788 nm, with a time-bandwidth product (TBP) of 0.46. The beam quality factors M 2 of 788 nm laser are measured to be M x 2 =1.38 and M y 2 =1.18, respectively.
data.title_cn: 高效率、广泛可调、绿光激光泵浦 BiB 3 O 6 飞秒 OPO，在 yz 平面内具有非共线相位匹配
data.abstract_cn: 展示了一种基于三硼酸铋（BIBO）晶体yz平面I型（o→e + e）非共线相位匹配的飞秒光学参量振荡器（fs-OPO），打破了共线相位匹配所设定的带宽（700-1900 nm）限制。泵浦源由自制 1040 nm Yb:光纤飞秒激光器的二次谐波（SH，520 nm）提供，脉冲持续时间为 177 fs，重复率为 100 MHz。实验上，通过调整 BIBO 晶体的角度，可以将波长从 626 nm 调谐到 3051 nm（信号波长为 626–1026 nm，闲频波长为 1067–3051 nm），据我们所知，这是任何基于 BIBO 的飞秒 OPO 的最宽波长调谐范围。在713 nm波长处，获得了1.3 W的最高平均功率，转换效率为37.1%。如果将信号功率和空闲功率都计算在内，总效率为 52%，这是一个新的基准。此外，在 788 nm 处测得压缩脉冲持续时间为 108 fs，时间带宽积 (TBP) 为 0.46。测得788nm激光器的光束质量因子M 2 分别为M x 2 =1.38和M y 2 =1.18。

data.title: Deep learning-assisted double strong coupling between multi-order anapoles and excitons
data.author: Ziqiao Liu, Yang Liao, Yuan Liu, Hanyang Gong, Zhengqi Liu, Jing Chen, Xianping Wang, Yanliang He, Xiaoshan Liu, Juan Chen, Guiqiang Liu
data.summary: High-order anapoles present strongly concentrated energy and narrow resonance widths and thus become burgeoning candidates in nonlinear optical conversion and strong coupling fields. Nevertheless, existing studies are rarely focused on strong coupling simultaneously involving multi-order anapoles. Herein, we theoretically construct a three-layer stacked hybrid system with a Si nanodisk sandwiched by the MoSe 2 and MoTe 2 nanodisks with the same radius based on the neural network constructed by deep learning (DL). First-order and second-order anapoles are excited simultaneously in this system and couple with excitons of bulk MoTe 2 and MoSe 2 nanodisks, respectively. Double strong coupling behaviors are achieved between the first-order anapole and the exciton of MoTe 2 , as well as the second-order anapole and the exciton of MoSe 2 , resulting in four energy branches with large Rabi splitting of 100.6 meV and 118.2 meV, respectively. Our work provides an effective approach for light–matter interaction involving multi-order anapoles and multiple excitons.
data.title_cn: 深度学习辅助多阶anapoles与激子之间的双强耦合
data.abstract_cn: 高阶Anapols具有高度集中的能量和窄的共振宽度，因此成为非线性光学转换和强耦合领域的新兴候选者。然而，现有的研究很少关注同时涉及多阶anapol的强耦合。在此，我们基于深度学习（DL）构建的神经网络，理论上构建了一个三层堆叠混合系统，其中Si纳米盘夹有相同半径的MoSe 2 和MoTe 2 纳米盘。在该系统中，一阶和二阶顺推子同时被激发，并分别与块体MoTe 2 和MoSe 2 纳米盘的激子耦合。一阶阿纳极子与MoTe 2 激子、二阶阿纳极子与MoSe 2 激子之间实现了双强耦合行为，产生了四个能量分支，分别具有100.6 meV和118.2 meV的大拉比分裂。我们的工作为涉及多级阿纳极和多激子的光与物质相互作用提供了一种有效的方法。

data.title: Co-integration of mesoporous GaN distributed Bragg reflectors and light-emitting diodes by transfer printing
data.author: Benoit Guilhabert, Miles Toon, Saptarsi Ghosh, Dimitars Jevtics, Zhongyi Xia, Menno Kappers, Martin D. Dawson, Rachel A. Oliver, Michael J. Strain
data.summary: Transfer printing is employed to demonstrate the integration of gallium nitride (GaN)-based distributed Bragg reflectors (DBR) with 100 μm lateral dimensions and reflectance of 90% in various formats. Mesoporous GaN DBRs are utilized as basic building blocks to fabricate more complex photonic devices directly on Silicon (Si) and glass receiving substrates. Multi-mode optical resonant cavities centered at 450 nm on Si are thus formed by direct stacking of two mesoporous DBR membranes. Furthermore, active devices are also demonstrated by combining mesoporous DBR with GaN-based light-emitting diodes membranes of similar dimensions, resulting in a Fabry–Perot-mediated emission with its main peak shifted by 14 nm compared to a reference device without DBR. Measured optical bandwidth of 136 MHz (−6 dB) in a small signal modulation scheme is also demonstrated from these devices.
data.title_cn: 通过转移印刷将介孔GaN分布布拉格反射器与发光二极管集成
data.abstract_cn: 采用转移印刷来演示基于氮化镓 (GaN) 的分布式布拉格反射器 (DBR) 的集成，横向尺寸为 100 μm，反射率为 90%，具有多种格式。介孔 GaN DBR 用作基本构件，可直接在硅 (Si) 和玻璃接收基板上制造更复杂的光子器件。因此，通过直接堆叠两个介孔 DBR 膜，在 Si 上形成以 450 nm 为中心的多模光学谐振腔。此外，还通过将介孔 DBR 与尺寸相似的 GaN 基发光二极管膜相结合来演示有源器件，从而产生法布里-珀罗介导发射，与没有 DBR 的参考器件相比，其主峰偏移了 14 nm。这些器件还展示了小信号调制方案中测得的 136 MHz (−6 dB) 光带宽。

data.title: Encrypted fringe projection profilometry
data.author: Yang Cheng, Zichen Gui, Le Guan, Ran Jin, Beiwen Li
data.summary: We propose encrypted fringe projection profilometry (E-FPP), a co-keyed phase-code framework that embeds encryption directly into the measurement process of fringe projection profilometry (FPP). Two random phase fields and orthogonal temporal codes jointly encode the projected sequence, binding phase retrieval to legitimate key pairs. The method preserves the standard three-step FPP operation while enabling key-dependent 3D reconstruction. Experiments verify accurate authorized reconstruction and strong resistance to single- and multi-frame inference, providing a privacy-preserving solution for optical metrology.
data.title_cn: 加密条纹投影轮廓测量
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了加密条纹投影轮廓测定法（E-FPP），这是一种共同密钥的相位代码框架，可将加密直接嵌入到条纹投影轮廓测定法（FPP）的测量过程中。两个随机相位场和正交时间码联合编码投影序列，将相位检索与合法密钥对绑定。该方法保留了标准的三步 FPP 操作，同时支持依赖于密钥的 3D 重建。实验验证了准确的授权重建以及对单帧和多帧推理的强大抵抗力，为光学计量提供了隐私保护解决方案。

data.title: An exponential curved crystal: design and performance for high-resolution X-ray spectroscopy
data.author: Jixin Yang, Jun Shi, Weixia Hu, Miao Li, Shali Xiao, Ruize Wang, Qichao Luo
data.summary: Based on the principles of Bragg diffraction and the Rowland circle geometry, we developed a novel, to the best of our knowledge, curved-crystal spectrometer featuring an exponentially shaped surface. This design facilitates high resolution and high photon collection efficiency over a broad energy range. Crucially, all image points for various X-ray energies lie precisely on the Rowland circle, and the lines connecting these image points to the source point are collinear. The spectrometer achieved a spectral resolution exceeding 18,000 in theoretical and simulation studies, which remained above 3,100 under experimental validation. This innovative and adaptable design offered promising potential for applications in plasma diagnostics and high-energy-density physics research.
data.title_cn: 指数弯曲晶体：高分辨率 X 射线光谱的设计和性能
data.abstract_cn: 据我们所知，基于布拉格衍射和罗兰圆几何原理，我们开发了一种新颖的曲面晶体光谱仪，具有指数形状的表面。这种设计有助于在广泛的能量范围内实现高分辨率和高光子收集效率。至关重要的是，各种 X 射线能量的所有图像点都精确地位于罗兰圆上，并且连接这些图像点与源点的线是共线的。该光谱仪在理论和模拟研究中实现了超过18,000的光谱分辨率，在实验验证中仍保持在3,100以上。这种创新且适应性强的设计为等离子体诊断和高能量密度物理研究的应用提供了广阔的前景。

data.title: Reconfiguring optical skyrmion topology in free space
data.author: Weiming Zhen, Zhiming Qing, Wenxiang Yan, Zhi-Cheng Ren, Xi-Lin Wang, Hui-Tian Wang, Jianping Ding, Yijie Shen
data.summary: Skyrmions, topological particle-like spin textures, have drawn significant interest in optics for their potential applications in robust information encoding and photonic manipulation. However, in free space, conventional skyrmionic beams suffer from passive and deterministic transformations in topological textures during propagation due to the Gouy phase effect, consequently limiting their stability and controllability. Here, we experimentally construct customizable Stokes skyrmions, providing unprecedented control over topologies (including skyrmion number and texture helicity) and propagation trajectory. This approach not only ensures the stable preservation of skyrmion textures over long distances but also enables customized transformations between distinct skyrmion types—anti-skyrmions, bimerons, and higher-order skyrmions—without relying on physical transformation elements. More importantly, we realize perfect optical skyrmions experimentally for the first time, to our knowledge. Additionally, we demonstrate the experimental generation of skyrmions along self-accelerating arbitrary trajectories, including parabolic and spiral paths. This work establishes a robust and reconfigurable platform for the manipulation of topological light fields, with significant implications for high-capacity optical coding, encryption, and precision particle manipulation.
data.title_cn: 自由空间中重新配置光学斯格明子拓扑
data.abstract_cn: 斯格明子是一种类似拓扑粒子的自旋纹理，因其在鲁棒信息编码和光子操纵方面的潜在应用而引起了光学界的极大兴趣。然而，在自由空间中，传统的斯格明子光束在传播过程中由于古伊相位效应而遭受拓扑结构的被动和确定性变换，从而限制了其稳定性和可控性。在这里，我们实验性地构造了可定制的斯托克斯斯格明子，提供了对拓扑（包括斯格明子数和纹理螺旋度）和传播轨迹的前所未有的控制。这种方法不仅可以确保长距离稳定保存斯格明子纹理，还可以在不同的斯格明子类型（反斯格明子、双默龙和高阶斯格明子）之间进行定制变换，而无需依赖物理变换元素。更重要的是，据我们所知，我们首次通过实验实现了完美的光学斯格明子。此外，我们还演示了沿自加速任意轨迹（包括抛物线和螺旋路径）实验生成斯格明子。这项工作为拓扑光场的操纵建立了一个强大且可重构的平台，对大容量光学编码、加密和精密粒子操纵具有重要意义。

data.title: Simultaneous estimation of absolute concentrations of chromophores and the differential pathlength factor in forearm muscle using spectral derivatives
data.author: Jeremy C. Hebden
data.summary: A method for estimating the absolute concentrations of chromophores in highly scattering tissues using near-infrared spectra is presented, which also yields estimates of the differential pathlength factor (DPF) and the power-dependency of scattering on wavelength. It involves measuring the attenuation spectral gradient and comparing it with an expression derived from diffusion theory. The validity of the approach is first explored using a diffusion model of light propagation in a homogenous slab, which is used to simulate measurements of diffuse reflectance in the adult forearm muscle during a vascular occlusion. Thereafter, the method is applied to experimental measurements performed on the forearms of five volunteers. The simulation results suggest that accuracy is significantly enhanced if some derived parameters are constrained to ranges which are physiologically realistic, and that the absolute concentrations of oxy- and deoxy-hemoglobin are estimated to within 40% and 20% of the true values, respectively. Furthermore, the wavelength-averaged DPF can be estimated to within around 10%. The measurements on volunteers revealed broadly consistent concentrations of the hemoglobins in the range 2-105 µM, and differential pathlength factors in the range 2.2-5.1.
data.title_cn: 使用光谱导数同时估计前臂肌肉中发色团的绝对浓度和微分路径长度因子
data.abstract_cn: 提出了一种使用近红外光谱估计高散射组织中发色团绝对浓度的方法，该方法还可以估计微分路径长度因子（DPF）和散射对波长的功率依赖性。它涉及测量衰减光谱梯度并将其与从扩散理论导出的表达式进行比较。首先使用均匀板中的光传播扩散模型探索该方法的有效性，该模型用于模拟血管闭塞期间成人前臂肌肉的漫反射测量。此后，该方法应用于对五名志愿者的前臂进行的实验测量。模拟结果表明，如果将一些导出的参数限制在生理上真实的范围内，并且氧合血红蛋白和脱氧血红蛋白的绝对浓度估计分别在真实值的 40% 和 20% 以内，则准确性会显着提高。此外，波长平均 DPF 的误差可估计在 10% 左右。对志愿者的测量显示，血红蛋白浓度在 2-105 µM 范围内大致一致，差异光程因子在 2.2-5.1 范围内。

data.title: Predicting wrist osteoporosis from excised human finger bones using spatially offset Raman spectroscopy – a cadaveric study
data.author: Mohammad Hosseini, Sadia Afrin, Anthony Yosick, Emma Schenker, Hani Awad, Andrew J. Berger
data.summary: Osteoporosis and osteopenia remain vastly underdiagnosed. Current clinical screening relies almost exclusively on dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), which measures bone mineral density (BMD) but fails to capture the compositional changes that lead to BMD loss. We investigated whether spatially offset Raman spectroscopy (SORS) applied to excised finger bones can assess subsurface biochemical markers associated with bone health and estimate wrist DXA T-scores. Raman spectra were acquired ex vivo on the mid-shaft of the proximal phalanx of the second digit from 25 female cadavers spanning the three T-score categories (n = 8 normal, n = 6 osteopenic, and n = 11 osteoporotic) at spatial offsets of 0, 3, and 6 mm from a laser irradiation spot. After normalizing spectra to the PO 4 3- peak, group-averaged spectra of the three categories, measured at 3-mm offset, showed clear differences in the CO 3 2- , Amide III, CH 2 , and Amide I bands. Quantitatively, four out of five mineral-to-matrix ratios discriminated (p ≤ 0.05) osteopenia from both normal and osteoporotic bone, and all five ratios showed significant differences between normal and osteoporotic bone. In contrast, the 0-mm offset showed reduced biochemical contrast in univariate analyses, while the 6-mm offset did not provide additional discrimination relative to 3-mm. Multivariate partial-least-squares regression (PLSR) models using 0-mm and 3-mm spectra predicted distal radius T-scores with comparable accuracy (Pearson r ≈ 0.90, RMSE CV ≈ 0.8), but the 3-mm offset required fewer latent variables (1 vs. 9), consistent with the univariate analysis trends favoring 3-mm offset. These excised-bone findings justify future studies extending this approach to transcutaneous fingers for non-ionizing assessment of bone health.
data.title_cn: 使用空间偏移拉曼光谱从切除的人指骨中预测腕部骨质疏松症——一项尸体研究
data.abstract_cn: 骨质疏松症和骨质减少症的诊断仍然严重不足。目前的临床筛查几乎完全依赖于双能 X 射线吸收测定法 (DXA)，它可以测量骨矿物质密度 (BMD)，但无法捕获导致 BMD 损失的成分变化。我们研究了应用于切除指骨的空间偏移拉曼光谱 (SORS) 是否可以评估与骨骼健康相关的地下生化标记物并估计手腕 DXA T 分数。拉曼光谱是在距激光照射点 0、3 和 6 mm 的空间偏移处从 25 具女性尸体的第二个手指近节指骨的中轴上离体获取的，这些尸体跨越三个 T 分数类别（n = 8 正常、n = 6 骨质减少和 n = 11 骨质疏松）。将光谱归一化为 PO 4 3- 峰后，以 3 毫米偏移测量的三类组平均光谱显示 CO 3 2- 、酰胺 III、CH 2 和酰胺 I 波段存在明显差异。从数量上讲，五分之四的矿物质与基质比率可区分（p≤0.05）正常骨和骨质疏松骨的骨质减少，并且所有五个比率都显示正常骨和骨质疏松骨之间存在显着差异。相比之下，0 毫米偏移在单变量分析中显示生化对比度降低，而 6 毫米偏移相对于 3 毫米没有提供额外的区分度。使用 0 毫米和 3 毫米谱的多元偏最小二乘回归 (PLSR) 模型以相当的精度预测远端半径 T 分数（Pearson r ≈ 0.90，RMSE CV ≈ 0.8），但 3 毫米偏移需要较少的潜在变量（1 比 9），这与有利于 3 毫米偏移的单变量分析趋势一致。这些切除骨骼的发现证明了未来的研究将这种方法扩展到经皮手指，以对骨骼健康进行非电离评估。

data.title: An inverse design method for generalized zero-étendue sources and two targets
data.author: Pieter Braam, Jan ten Thije Boonkkamp, Martijn Anthonissen, Koondanibha Mitra, Lisa Kusch, Wilbert IJzerman
data.summary: We present an inverse method to compute freeform optical surfaces that transform a light distribution, parameterized by two source planes, into two separate target distributions. The surfaces can be reflectors or lenses, and control both the spatial and directional source and target coordinates of light rays. From energy conservation we derive Jacobian equations for optical mappings, and the optical path length provides generating functions for the optical surfaces. A three-stage least-squares algorithm numerically solves the resulting equations. We present examples with complex source and target distributions.
data.title_cn: 广义零光展量源和两个目标的逆设计方法
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种计算自由形状光学表面的逆方法，该方法将由两个源平面参数化的光分布转换为两个单独的目标分布。这些表面可以是反射器或透镜，并控制光线的空间和方向源和目标坐标。根据能量守恒，我们推导出光学映射的雅可比方程，并且光路长度提供了光学表面的生成函数。三阶段最小二乘算法对所得方程进行数值求解。我们提供具有复杂源和目标分布的示例。

data.title: Sensitivity‐Tunable Complex Permittivity Sensing Enabled by Bound States in the Continuum in a Waveguide‐Resonator System
data.author: Yuhang Yang, Yinbing An, Yu Chen, Yihao Yang, Zi‐lan Deng, Yulan Huang, Shangli Tang, Tao Fu
data.summary: ABSTRACT Bound states in the continuum (BICs), featuring strong field confinement and theoretically infinite quality factors, offer a powerful mechanism for enhancing light–matter interactions. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a universal strategy to construct and merge two types of BICs in a compact metallic rectangular waveguide‐cuboid resonator system in the microwave regime. Leveraging the high‐ quasi‐BICs, a sensitivity‐tunable complex permittivity sensor is developed, with sensing sensitivity adjustable through waveguide‐resonator structural parameters. A first‐principles analysis establishes a quantitative relationship between the transmission coefficient and the material's complex permittivity, enabling simultaneous extraction of the real part and loss tangent. The sensor's accuracy is validated using commercial microwave dielectric substrates with well‐defined permittivities, and its tunable sensitivity is further confirmed through cross‐check experiments. Compared with representative microwave permittivity sensors, the proposed approach achieves over 90% improvement in frequency detection resolution and nearly fivefold enhancement in normalized sensitivity. Benefiting from its ultrahigh quality factor, tunable sensitivity, and first‐principles‐guided design, the sensor can be extended to different frequencies and structural configurations, while allowing convenient sample replacement. These features make it highly suitable for RF substrate characterization, laboratory‐scale material screening, and other high‐sensitivity microwave sensing applications.
data.title_cn: 波导谐振器系统中连续体束缚态实现的灵敏度可调复介电常数传感
data.abstract_cn: 摘要连续体束缚态（BIC）具有强场限制和理论上无限的品质因数，为增强光与物质相互作用提供了强大的机制。在这里，我们提出并通过实验证明了一种通用策略，用于在微波范围内的紧凑金属矩形波导-长方体谐振器系统中构建和合并两种类型的 BIC。利用高准BIC，开发了一种灵敏度可调的复介电常数传感器，其传感灵敏度可通过波导谐振器结构参数进行调节。第一原理分析建立了传输系数和材料复介电常数之间的定量关系，从而能够同时提取实部和损耗角正切。使用具有明确介电常数的商用微波介电基板验证了传感器的准确性，并通过交叉检查实验进一步证实了其可调灵敏度。与代表性的微波介电常数传感器相比，所提出的方法在频率检测分辨率方面实现了 90% 以上的改进，在归一化灵敏度方面提高了近五倍。得益于其超高的品质因数、可调的灵敏度和第一性原理指导的设计，该传感器可以扩展到不同的频率和结构配置，同时允许方便的样品更换。这些功能使其非常适合射频基板表征、实验室规模的材料筛选和其他高灵敏度微波传感应用。

data.title: Tailoring Spatial Correlations With Quantum Interference
data.author: Carlo Schiano, Bereneice Sephton, Elnaz Darsheshdar, Lorenzo Marrucci, Corrado de Lisio, Vincenzo D'Ambrosio
data.summary: ABSTRACT Photon correlations represent a central resource in many quantum optics experiments, with applications ranging from quantum information protocols to sensing. Engineering such correlations is often challenging, especially in multi‐particle scenarios. This work describes an effective method for shaping spatial correlations between photons by patterning their distinguishability in a quantum interference setup. How one may write and edit these bi‐photon correlations between the two output channels of a beam‐splitter is presented, where the information encoded remains hidden from conventional intensity measurements. The scheme presented here offers an easy extension to multiparticle scenarios and facilitates the transmission of high‐dimensional quantum information, opening new avenues for applications in quantum technologies and imaging protocols.
data.title_cn: 利用量子干涉调整空间相关性
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 光子相关性是许多量子光学实验的核心资源，其应用范围从量子信息协议到传感。设计这种相关性通常具有挑战性，尤其是在多粒子场景中。这项工作描述了一种通过在量子干涉装置中图案化光子之间的可区分性来塑造光子之间的空间相关性的有效方法。介绍了如何编写和编辑分束器两个输出通道之间的这些双光子相关性，其中编码的信息仍然隐藏在传统强度测量中。这里提出的方案提供了对多粒子场景的简单扩展，并促进高维量子信息的传输，为量子技术和成像协议的应用开辟了新的途径。

data.title: Large‐Scale Monolithically‐Integrated High‐Speed Interconnect Chips via Direct Growth of InAs/GaAs Quantum Dot Lasers and Photodetectors on Si(001)
data.author: Shenglin Wang, Yueying Niu, Wanlin Liu, Kehan Jiang, Kun Zhou, Hongyu Chai, Dan Lu, Xiaoguang Yang, Tao Yang
data.summary: ABSTRACT Silicon photonic integrated circuits (PICs) have emerged as cutting‐edge platforms for optical communication, interconnection, photonic computing, and sensing, delivering exceptional data throughput and energy‐efficient operation. A holy grail is the realization of light sources and photonic components monolithically integrated on a single silicon wafer. However, such integration faces formidable challenges in material engineering and integration techniques, especially for on‐chip light sources. Here, we propose a strategy for developing large‐scale monolithically‐integrated high‐speed interconnect chips via direct epitaxy of quantum dot (QD) materials on CMOS‐compatible (001) silicon substrate. On the basis of an eight‐layer QD epitaxial structure, we simultaneously fabricate direct modulation lasers and waveguide photodetectors (PDs) for emission and reception. Bandwidth measurements for the single QD lasers and PDs reveal 3 dB bandwidths of 4.5 GHz and 2.02 GHz, respectively. Non‐return‐to‐zero (NRZ) signal measurements show that the laser can achieve a maximum direct modulation rate of 12.5 Gbit/s, whereas the PD has a data reception capability of 5 Gbit/s. Moreover, a state‐of‐the‐art link rate of 1.01 GHz for on‐chip optical interconnection between the integrated lasers and PDs is demonstrated through a free‐space optical coupling structure. This work demonstrates a novel method to realize large‐scale monolithically‐integrated chips, which enables future versatile applications.
data.title_cn: 通过在 Si(001) 上直接生长 InAs/GaAs 量子点激光器和光电探测器来实现大规模单片集成高速互连芯片
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 硅光子集成电路 (PIC) 已成为光通信、互连、光子计算和传感的尖端平台，可提供卓越的数据吞吐量和节能运行。圣杯是实现将光源和光子元件单片集成在单个硅晶圆上。然而，这种集成在材料工程和集成技术方面面临着巨大的挑战，特别是对于片上光源。在这里，我们提出了一种通过在 CMOS 兼容 (001) 硅基板上直接外延量子点 (QD) 材料来开发大规模单片集成高速互连芯片的策略。在八层QD外延结构的基础上，我们同时制造了直接调制激光器和用于发射和接收的波导光电探测器（PD）。单个 QD 激光器和 PD 的带宽测量结果分别显示 4.5 GHz 和 2.02 GHz 的 3 dB 带宽。不归零（NRZ）信号测量表明，激光器可以实现最大12.5 Gbit/s的直接调制速率，而PD的数据接收能力为5 Gbit/s。此外，通过自由空间光学耦合结构展示了集成激光器和 PD 之间片上光学互连的最先进的 1.01 GHz 链路速率。这项工作展示了一种实现大规模单片集成芯片的新方法，可以实现未来的多功能应用。

data.title: Low-threshold interlayer exciton multiplication in twisted transition metal dichalcogenides heterobilayers
data.author: Pengzhi Wang, Gan Wang, Chenhao Wang, Qi Wei, Yuxuan Chen, Qi Liu, Luwei Zhou, Hui Ren, Xiang Zhang, Jiangbo Peng, Leyi Zhao, Tao-Yuan Du, Mingjie Li
data.summary: Abstract Multiple exciton generation (MEG) from single-photon absorption can enhance quantum efficiencies in light emission and energy conversion. However, its practical application is limited by high photon-energy thresholds, large material bandgaps, and rapid exciton recombination. Here, we report the observation of interlayer exciton multiplication (IXM) in twisted van der Waals heterobilayers, where the process threshold is as low as twice the type-II bandgap and the resulting multiple interlayer excitons (IXs) exhibit nanosecond-scale lifetimes. These properties directly address the core challenges of MEG, leading to a significant boost in both interlayer exciton emission and photocurrent quantum efficiency. Theoretical calculations confirm the experimental results, revealing that low-threshold IXM is facilitated by interlayer hot-carrier scattering and is accompanied by attractive IX interactions, even at larger twist angles where momentum mismatch is significant. Twist-angle-induced momentum mismatches have a minimal impact on the IXM threshold due to strong hot-carrier interlayer transfer and efficient intervalley impact ionization. The IXM efficiency reaches ~90% in small-twist-angle heterobilayers but decreases at larger angles and higher pump photon energies, a trend attributed to reduced interlayer hot-carrier Coulomb scattering. Furthermore, we demonstrate photocurrent multiplication driven by IXM. Applied electric fields further lower the IXM threshold and increase the IX yield, enabling a twofold enhancement in quantum efficiency and a fourfold increase in responsivity in a self-powered heterobilayer photodiode. Our results establish IXM as a promising mechanism for high-efficiency carrier-multiplication optoelectronics and provide insights into the many-body physics of stable multiple excitons.
data.title_cn: 扭曲过渡金属二硫属化物异质双层中的低阈值层间激子倍增
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 单光子吸收产生多激子（MEG）可以提高光发射和能量转换的量子效率。然而，其实际应用受到高光子能量阈值、大材料带隙和快速激子复合的限制。在这里，我们报告了扭曲范德华异质双层中层间激子倍增（IXM）的观察，其中过程阈值低至II型带隙的两倍，并且由此产生的多个层间激子（IX）表现出纳秒级的寿命。这些特性直接解决了 MEG 的核心挑战，从而显着提高了层间激子发射和光电流量子效率。理论计算证实了实验结果，表明低阈值 IXM 是由层间热载流子散射促进的，并且伴随着有吸引力的 IX 相互作用，即使在动量失配显着的较大扭转角下也是如此。由于强大的热载流子层间转移和高效的层间碰撞电离，扭转角引起的动量失配对 IXM 阈值的影响很小。在小扭转角异质双层中，IXM 效率达到约 90%，但在较大角度和较高泵浦光子能量下会降低，这一趋势归因于层间热载流子库仑散射的减少。此外，我们还演示了 IXM 驱动的光电流倍增。施加的电场进一步降低了 IXM 阈值并增加了 IX 产率，从而使自供电异质双层光电二极管的量子效率提高了一倍，响应率提高了四倍。我们的研究结果确立了 IXM 作为高效载流子倍增光电子学的一种有前途的机制，并为稳定多激子的多体物理提供了见解。

data.title: A federated deep learning approach for SDN security with quantum optimized feature selection and hybrid MSDC net architecture
data.author: S. Rohith, G. Logeswari, K. Tamilarasi, G. Sudhakaran
data.summary: Software-Defined Networking (SDN) is increasingly exposed to complex cyberattacks, requiring advanced, adaptive, and efficient intrusion detection mechanisms. This study presents LightIDS-SDN, a federated and explainable intrusion detection framework tailored for SDN environments. At its core, the system employs Dual Fitness Enhanced Quantum-Inspired Particle Swarm Optimization (DFE-GQPSO) for feature selection, which identifies the most informative network attributes while eliminating redundant or irrelevant features. This quantum-optimized feature selection significantly improves detection performance by reducing overfitting and enhancing generalization. The framework incorporates a hybrid deep learning architecture, MSDC-Net, combining Transformer layers, Capsule Networks, and BiLSTM units to capture contextual, spatial, and sequential dependencies in network traffic. Federated learning using FedAvg enables collaborative model training across multiple SDN controllers while preserving data privacy. Explainable AI modules, based on SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM), provide both global and local interpretability, ensuring transparent and accountable decision-making. Experiments on the InSDN dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system, achieving 98.73% accuracy, 98.80% precision, 98.65% recall, and 98.72% F1-score. Comparative analysis confirms that DFE-GQPSO outperforms traditional feature selection methods, enhancing model robustness and training efficiency. Overall, LightIDS-SDN effectively detects a wide range of SDN attacks while addressing limitations of conventional IDS approaches, including limited scalability, lack of interpretability, and computational inefficiency. This work lays the foundation for deploying quantum-optimized, explainable, and federated intrusion detection systems in SDN networks.
data.title_cn: 具有量子优化特征选择和混合 MSDC 网络架构的 SDN 安全联合深度学习方法
data.abstract_cn: 软件定义网络 (SDN) 越来越多地面临复杂的网络攻击，需要先进、自适应且高效的入侵检测机制。这项研究提出了 LightIDS-SDN，这是一个专为 SDN 环境量身定制的联合且可解释的入侵检测框架。该系统的核心采用双适应度增强量子粒子群优化 (DFE-GQPSO) 进行特征选择，可识别信息最丰富的网络属性，同时消除冗余或不相关的特征。这种量子优化的特征选择通过减少过度拟合和增强泛化能力显着提高了检测性能。该框架采用混合深度学习架构 MSDC-Net，结合 Transformer 层、胶囊网络和 BiLSTM 单元来捕获网络流量中的上下文、空间和顺序依赖性。使用 FedAvg 的联合学习可以跨多个 SDN 控制器进行协作模型训练，同时保护数据隐私。可解释的人工智能模块基于 SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 和梯度加权类激活映射 (Grad-CAM)，提供全局和本地可解释性，确保透明和负责任的决策。 InSDN 数据集上的实验证明了该系统的有效性，实现了 98.73% 的准确率、98.80% 的精确度、98.65% 的召回率和 98.72% 的 F1 分数。对比分析证实，DFE-GQPSO 优于传统的特征选择方法，增强了模型的鲁棒性和训练效率。总体而言，LightIDS-SDN 可以有效检测各种 SDN 攻击，同时解决传统 IDS 方法的局限性，包括可扩展性有限、缺乏可解释性和计算效率低下。这项工作为在 SDN 网络中部署量子优化、可解释的联合入侵检测系统奠定了基础。

data.title: High-efficiency generation of Bessel–Gaussian vortex beams using Bessel-phase-embedded fork-shaped holograms
data.author: Ali Mohammad Khazaei, Saifollah Rasouli, Sergey A. Ponomarenko, Davud Hebri
data.summary: In this paper, we present a high-efficiency protocol for constructing pure amplitude and phase Bessel-phase-embedded fork-shaped holograms to generate Bessel–Gaussian vortex (BGV) beams. When illuminated with a Gaussian beam, these holograms produce BGV beams in the first diffraction orders. To quantify the performance of the generated beams, we introduce a quality factor that measures the degree of similarity between the generated BGV beam and an ideal BGV beam. Our results demonstrate that the proposed holograms achieve a significantly higher level of similarity compared to the conventional method of generating BGV beams, which involves the sequential use of a spiral phase plate (SPP) and an axicon or their equivalent computer-generated holograms. Additionally, we compare the diffraction efficiency of BGV beams generated using our approach for both pure amplitude and phase holograms. Phase holograms are implemented using a spatial light modulator (SLM), whereas pure amplitude holograms are printed on sheet glass or plastic substrates. The use of pure amplitude holograms offers a highly efficient, cost-effective, and straightforward method for generating BGV beams, making them an attractive alternative to traditional techniques.
data.title_cn: 使用贝塞尔相位嵌入叉形全息图高效生成贝塞尔-高斯涡旋光束
data.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提出了一种高效协议，用于构建纯振幅和相位贝塞尔相位嵌入叉形全息图以生成贝塞尔-高斯涡旋（BGV）光束。当用高斯光束照射时，这些全息图会产生第一衍射级的 BGV 光束。为了量化生成的光束的性能，我们引入了一个品质因数来衡量生成的 BGV 光束与理想 BGV 光束之间的相似程度。我们的结果表明，与生成 BGV 光束的传统方法相比，所提出的全息图实现了显着更高的相似度，传统方法涉及顺序使用螺旋相位板（SPP）和轴棱镜或等效的计算机生成全息图。此外，我们还比较了使用我们的方法生成纯振幅全息图和相位全息图的 BGV 光束的衍射效率。相位全息图是使用空间光调制器（SLM）实现的，而纯振幅全息图则印刷在玻璃板或塑料基板上。纯振幅全息图的使用提供了一种高效、经济且简单的 BGV 光束生成方法，使其成为传统技术的有吸引力的替代方案。

data.title: Electric-magnetic-switchable free-space skyrmions in toroidal light pulses via a nonlinear metasurface
data.author: Li Niu, Xi Feng, Xueqian Zhang, Wangke Yu, Qingwei Wang, Yuanhao Lang, Quan Xu, Xieyu Chen, Jiajun Ma, Haidi Qiu, Yijie Shen, Weili Zhang, Jiaguang Han
data.summary: Recent advances reveal that light propagation in free space supports many exotic topological textures, such as skyrmions. Their unique space–time topologies make them promising candidates as next-generation robust information carriers. Hence, the ability of switching different texture modes to serve as a manner of data transfer is in high demand. However, previous studies focus on generation of one specific mode, lacking integrated devices with externally variable and stable mode generation capability. Here, we experimentally demonstrate the realization of switchable skyrmions between electric and magnetic modes in toroidal light pulses (TLPs) using a nonlinear metasurface platform in terms of broadband terahertz (THz) generation driven by a vectorial pulse. The spatial and temporal evolutions of them are also clearly observed. Our work establishes a new paradigm, to our knowledge, for manipulating and switching topologically structured light.
data.title_cn: 通过非线性超表面实现环形光脉冲中的电磁可切换自由空间斯格明子
data.abstract_cn: 最近的进展表明，自由空间中的光传播支持许多奇异的拓扑纹理，例如斯格明子。它们独特的时空拓扑使它们成为下一代强大信息载体的有希望的候选者。因此，非常需要切换不同纹理模式作为数据传输方式的能力。然而，以往的研究主要集中于一种特定模式的生成，缺乏具有外部可变和稳定模式生成能力的集成器件。在这里，我们通过实验证明了在由矢量脉冲驱动的宽带太赫兹（THz）生成方面，使用非线性超表面平台实现了环形光脉冲（TLP）中电模式和磁模式之间可切换的斯格明子。它们的空间和时间演变也被清晰地观察到。据我们所知，我们的工作建立了一个新的范例，用于操纵和切换拓扑结构光。

data.title: Direct preference optimization-based adaptive control for minimizing total harmonic distortion in photovoltaic-powered electric drives
data.author: R. K. Ragavapriya, Maruthupandi Perumal
data.summary: In order to reduce Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) in electric drives that are driven by photovoltaic (PV) systems, this study suggests a unique Direct Preference Optimization-based Photovoltaic Voltage Control (DPO-PVC) framework. In order to simulate realistic operating circumstances, framework combines dynamic PV modelling, inverter management, and electric motor simulation with real-world solar irradiance data from NREL PVDAQ dataset. DPO approach, in contrast to conventional scalar loss-based techniques, adapts robustly to nonlinear, noisy, and time-varying environments by learning from preference rankings across controller configurations. efficiency of suggested controller is shown by extensive simulations conducted under various irradiance profiles, including clear, cloudy, and transient weather situations, as well as dynamic load scenarios. According to quantitative studies, DPO-PVC outperforms PID, fuzzy-PID, and genetic algorithm-optimized PID (GA-PID) controllers by up to 60%, achieving a voltage THD as low as 2.88%. Likewise, current THD drops to 2.57%, guaranteeing better motor current quality. Additionally, controller has a smaller speed regulation error (1.49%) and a faster settling time (180 ms), which enhances system stability and dynamic response. Achieving 94.6% energy efficiency highlights best use of solar electricity that is available. Further tests demonstrate DPO-PVC controller’s practical usefulness by demonstrating that it retains performance robustness against irradiance changes, abrupt load surges, and sensor noise. efficacy of choice-based training is confirmed by learning convergence metrics, which show that preference accuracy exceeds 95% after 50 epochs. All things considered, DPO-PVC framework offers a noteworthy development in PV-powered electric drive control by successfully lowering harmonic distortion while boosting efficiency and stability. This method has a lot of promise for practical renewable energy systems that need high-fidelity, adaptive control in a variety of load and environmental scenarios.
data.title_cn: 基于直接偏好优化的自适应控制，可最大限度地减少光伏驱动器中的总谐波失真
data.abstract_cn: 为了减少光伏 (PV) 系统驱动的电力驱动器中的总谐波失真 (THD)，本研究提出了一种独特的基于直接偏好优化的光伏电压控制 (DPO-PVC) 框架。为了模拟真实的操作环境，框架将动态光伏建模、逆变器管理和电动机模拟与来自 NREL PVDAQ 数据集的真实太阳辐照度数据相结合。与传统的基于标量损失的技术相比，DPO 方法通过学习跨控制器配置的偏好排名，可以稳健地适应非线性、噪声和时变环境。通过在各种辐照度曲线下进行的广泛模拟，包括晴朗、阴天和瞬态天气情况以及动态负载场景，显示了建议控制器的效率。根据定量研究，DPO-PVC 的性能优于 PID、模糊 PID 和遗传算法优化 PID (GA-PID) 控制器高达 60%，电压 THD 低至 2.88%。同样，电流THD降至2.57%，保证了更好的电机电流质量。此外，控制器具有更小的调速误差（1.49%）和更快的稳定时间（180 ms），增强了系统稳定性和动态响应。实现 94.6% 的能源效率凸显了对现有太阳能电力的最佳利用。进一步的测试证明了 DPO-PVC 控制器的实际用途，证明它对辐照度变化、突然的负载浪涌和传感器噪声保持了性能鲁棒性。基于选择的训练的有效性通过学习收敛指标得到证实，该指标表明在 50 个 epoch 后偏好准确度超过 95%。综合考虑，DPO-PVC 框架成功降低了谐波失真，同时提高了效率和稳定性，为光伏电力驱动控制领域带来了值得注意的发展。这种方法对于需要在各种负载和环境场景下进行高保真、自适应控制的实际可再生能源系统具有很大的前景。

data.title: Expanding SARS-CoV-2 antigen targets beyond spike using a baculovirus expression system
data.author: Adnan Asadbeigi, Amirhossein Razavirad, Fatemeh Khajehahmadi, Mohsen Eghtedari, Reza Shirkoohi
data.summary: The ongoing antigenic evolution of SARS-CoV-2, particularly within the spike glycoprotein, threatens the long-term efficacy of spike-focused vaccines and serodiagnostics. While most authorized COVID-19 vaccines exclusively target the spike protein, growing evidence underscores multivalent strategies incorporating conserved viral antigens. Here, we employed a baculovirus expression vector system (BEVS) to co-express all four structural proteins, including spike, nucleocapsid, membrane, and envelope, in Sf9 insect cells. Surface-displayed antigens were used in a cell-based ELISA to profile IgG responses in convalescent sera. All antigens elicited detectable antibody binding, with nucleocapsid and membrane proteins provoking significantly stronger responses than spike (p < 0.001), and envelope protein showing intermediate reactivity. Statistical analyses revealed distinct patterns of antigenic reactivity. These findings validate the utility of BEVS for multiplex antigen presentation and highlight the immunological and diagnostic value of conserved non-spike antigens. Combined, this study advocates multivalent vaccine strategies and refines serodiagnostics by leveraging broader antigenic targets to counter immune escape.
data.title_cn: 使用杆状病毒表达系统将 SARS-CoV-2 抗原靶点扩展到尖峰以外
data.abstract_cn: SARS-CoV-2 持续的抗原进化，特别是在刺突糖蛋白内，威胁着针对刺突的疫苗和血清诊断的长期疗效。虽然大多数授权的 COVID-19 疫苗专门针对刺突蛋白，但越来越多的证据强调了结合保守病毒抗原的多价策略。在这里，我们采用杆状病毒表达载体系统（BEVS）在 Sf9 昆虫细胞中共表达所有四种结构蛋白，包括刺突蛋白、核衣壳蛋白、膜蛋白和包膜蛋白。在基于细胞的 ELISA 中使用表面展示的抗原来分析恢复期血清中的 IgG 反应。所有抗原均引发可检测的抗体结合，核衣壳和膜蛋白引发的反应明显强于尖峰 (p < 0.001)，包膜蛋白显示出中等反应性。统计分析揭示了不同的抗原反应模式。这些发现验证了 BEVS 在多重抗原呈递方面的实用性，并强调了保守非刺突抗原的免疫学和诊断价值。结合起来，这项研究提倡多价疫苗策略，并通过利用更广泛的抗原靶标来对抗免疫逃逸来完善血清诊断。

data.title: Class-attention pooling and token sparsity based vision transformers for chest X-ray interpretation
data.author: Vaibhav Lokunde, Keerthan Sundar, Anuj Khokhar, Bhawana Tyagi, Naga Priyadarsini R, MohanKumar B
data.summary: Chest radiography is the most widely used imaging technique for the diagnosing of lung diseases, but interpreting X-rays can be very difficult due to the subtle abnormalities and variations in image quality taken during X-rays. While deep learning models, especially the Convolution Neural Networks (CNNs), have shown strong performance when it comes to detecting pneumonia and other conditions, Vision Transformers (ViTs) have recently surpassed CNNs on several chest X-ray benchmarks by dividing images into small patches and learning global relationships. However, standard ViTs can sometimes focus on irrelevant regions, making their decisions less interpretable. To address this, we propose an enhanced ViT model tailored for chest X-ray analysis that prioritizes both accuracy and explainability. Our model introduces class-attention pooling technique, where each disease-specific class token learns to highlight relevant regions of the image, improving disease-wise focus. Token sparsity and random token dropping further help the model attend to only the most informative patches, enhancing robustness against noise. A convolutional stem is added before patch creation to extract fine local features like edges and textures, ensuring early capture of lung-specific patterns. Additionally, each X-ray undergoes preprocessing using Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE), which enhances local contrast and makes subtle lesions more visible. The model is trained with mixed-precision computation, a warm-up cosine learning rate schedule, and the AdamW optimizer, allowing stable and efficient training on large datasets. It is then evaluated on Tuberculosis Chest X-Rays and Pulmonary Chest X-Rays datasets which are publicly available, the proposed framework achieved 99.19% Training accuracy, a Validation Accuracy of 97.78%, an F1-score of 0.94, and an AUC of 0.99, outperforming the baseline ViT. It is pointed out that the above scores are obtained based on the image-level split, owing to the limitations of the dataset, and the performance may be over-estimated compared to the validation on the patient level. The Grad-CAM heatmaps further confirm the fact that the model focuses on clinically relevant areas such as opacities or nodules, reinforcing interpretability and trust. Overall, this improved ViT framework offers both high diagnostic accuracy and also clear visual explanations, implying its possible usage in acting as an AI assistant for radiologists in efficiently detecting lung diseases.
data.title_cn: 用于胸部 X 射线解读的基于类注意力池和令牌稀疏性的视觉变换器
data.abstract_cn: 胸部 X 光检查是诊断肺部疾病最广泛使用的成像技术，但由于 X 光检查过程中拍摄的图像质量存在细微的异常和变化，因此解释 X 光检查可能非常困难。虽然深度学习模型，尤其是卷积神经网络 (CNN) 在检测肺炎和其他疾病方面表现出了强大的性能，但视觉变换器 (ViT) 最近通过将图像划分为小块并学习全局关系，在多个胸部 X 射线基准测试中超越了 CNN。然而，标准 ViT 有时可能会关注不相关的区域，从而使其决策难以解释。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种专为胸部 X 射线分析而定制的增强型 ViT 模型，该模型优先考虑准确性和可解释性。我们的模型引入了类注意力池技术，其中每个特定于疾病的类标记学习突出图像的相关区域，从而改善疾病方面的焦点。令牌稀疏性和随机令牌丢弃进一步帮助模型只关注信息最丰富的补丁，从而增强对噪声的鲁棒性。在创建补丁之前添加一个卷积茎，以提取边缘和纹理等精细的局部特征，确保尽早捕获肺部特定的模式。此外，每张 X 射线都使用对比度有限自适应直方图均衡 (CLAHE) 进行预处理，从而增强局部对比度并使细微病变更加明显。该模型使用混合精度计算、预热余弦学习率计划和 AdamW 优化器进行训练，从而可以在大型数据集上进行稳定且高效的训练。然后在公开的结核病胸部 X 光和肺胸部 X 光数据集上进行评估，所提出的框架实现了 99.19% 的训练准确率、97.78% 的验证准确度、0.94 的 F1 分数和 0.99 的 AUC，优于基线 ViT。需要指出的是，由于数据集的限制，上述分数是基于图像级别的分割获得的，与患者级别的验证相比，性能可能被高估。 Grad-CAM 热图进一步证实了这样一个事实：该模型侧重于临床相关区域，例如混浊或结节，从而增强了可解释性和信任度。总体而言，这种改进的 ViT 框架既提供了高诊断准确性，又提供了清晰的视觉解释，这意味着它可以作为放射科医生的人工智能助手，有效地检测肺部疾病。

data.title: Chemical synthesis of novel aminopyrimidin-4-yl-1H-pyrazole derivatives as spleen tyrosine kinase (SYK) inhibitors
data.author: K. V. Rajasheker, M. S. Pallavi, Pallavi Singh, Victor Stupin, Ekaterina Silina, Kavitharaj Varadaraju, Mohammad Y. Alfaifi, Ali A. Shati, Serag Eldin I. Elbehairi, Chandan Shivamallu, Manvi, P. C. Arun, Shiva Prasad Kollur
data.summary: Spleen tyrosine kinase (SYK) plays a pivotal role in immunoreceptor signalling pathways implicated in various cancers and autoimmune diseases. Inhibition of SYK has shown therapeutic potential by attenuating immune-mediated damage and suppressing tumour growth. This study reports the synthesis, characterization, and evaluation of a novel series of aminopyrimidin-4-yl-1H-pyrazole derivatives (31, 35, 36, 37, 39, 41, 44, 47 and 49) as selective SYK inhibitors. The chemically synthesized molecules were structurally confirmed using 1H, 13C NMR and mass spectrometry techniques. Further, molecular docking studies revealed differential binding affinities with the SYK active site, highlighting molecule 44 as the lead candidate, displaying the lowest docking score and strongest interactions. Subsequent 200 ns molecular dynamics simulations confirmed the enhanced stability of 44 in complex with SYK, evidenced by consistent hydrogen bonding, minimal root-mean square deviation (RMSD), and compact protein folding relative to other ligands. Furthermore, binding free energy calculations corroborated the favourable energetic profile of 44. Also, principal component and free energy landscape analyses showed that 44 maintained a single, stable conformational state with limited flexibility. On the other hand, in vitro enzyme inhibition assays employing a luminescence-based kinase activity system demonstrated that several compounds, particularly 44, exhibited potent concentration and time-dependent inhibition of SYK inhibition activity. Kinetic characterization revealed that 44 functions via a non-competitive inhibition mechanism, suggesting allosteric binding outside the ATP substrate site. These integrative in silico and in vitro findings establish 44 as a promising lead molecule for SYK-targeted therapies, combining potent binding affinity, conformational stability, and effective enzyme inhibition. This work advances the design of novel small-molecule SYK inhibitors with potential applications in cancer and autoimmune disease treatment.
data.title_cn: 化学合成新型氨基嘧啶-4-基-1H-吡唑衍生物作为脾酪氨酸激酶（SYK）抑制剂
data.abstract_cn: 脾酪氨酸激酶 (SYK) 在与各种癌症和自身免疫性疾病有关的免疫受体信号传导通路中发挥着关键作用。 SYK 的抑制已显示出通过减轻免疫介导的损伤和抑制肿瘤生长的治疗潜力。本研究报告了一系列新型氨基嘧啶-4-基-1H-吡唑衍生物（31、35、36、37、39、41、44、47 和 49）作为选择性 SYK 抑制剂的合成、表征和评估。使用 1H、13C NMR 和质谱技术对化学合成的分子进行了结构确认。此外，分子对接研究揭示了与 SYK 活性位点的不同结合亲和力，突出分子 44 作为主要候选者，显示出最低的对接分数和最强的相互作用。随后的 200 ns 分子动力学模拟证实了 44 与 SYK 复合物的稳定性增强，这通过相对于其他配体的一致氢键、最小均方根偏差 (RMSD) 和紧凑的蛋白质折叠来证明。此外，结合自由能计算证实了 44 有利的能量分布。此外，主成分和自由能景观分析表明 44 保持单一、稳定的构象状态，但灵活性有限。另一方面，采用基于发光的激酶活性系统的体外酶抑制测定表明，几种化合物，特别是 44，对 SYK 抑制活性表现出有效的浓度和时间依赖性抑制。动力学表征表明 44 通过非竞争性抑制机制发挥作用，表明在 ATP 底物位点外进行变构结合。这些综合的计算机和体外研究结果表明 44 是一种有前途的 SYK 靶向治疗先导分子，结合了强大的结合亲和力、构象稳定性和有效的酶抑制作用。这项工作推进了新型小分子 SYK 抑制剂的设计，具有在癌症和自身免疫性疾病治疗中的潜在应用。

data.title: Compendia: Automated Visual Storytelling Generation from Online Article Collection
data.author: Manusha Karunathilaka, Litian Lei, Yiming Gao, Yong Wang, Jiannan Li
data.summary: In the digital age, readers value quantitative journalism that is clear, concise, analytical, and human–centred. To understand complex topics, they often piece together scattered facts from multiple articles. Visual storytelling can transform fragmented information into clear, engaging narratives, yet its use with unstructured online articles remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we present Compendia , an automated system that analyzes online articles in response to a user's query and generates a coherent data story tailored to the user's informational needs. through two modules covering addresses key challenges of storytelling from unstructured text through two modules covering: Online Article Retrieval , which gathers relevant articles; Data Fact Extraction , which identifies, validates, and refines quantitative facts; Fact Organization , which clusters and merges related facts into coherent thematic groups; and Visual Storytelling , which transforms the organized facts into narratives with visualizations in an interactive scrollytelling interface. We evaluated Compendia through a quantitative analysis, confirming the accuracy in fact extraction and organization, and through two user studies with 16 participants, demonstrating its usability, effectiveness, and ability to produce engaging visual stories for open-ended queries.
data.title_cn: 概要：从在线文章集合中自动生成视觉叙事
data.abstract_cn: 在数字时代，读者看重清晰、简洁、分析性强和以人为本的定量新闻。为了理解复杂的主题，他们经常将多篇文章中分散的事实拼凑起来。视觉叙事可以将碎片信息转化为清晰、引人入胜的叙述，但其在非结构化在线文章中的使用在很大程度上尚未得到探索。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了 Compendia，这是一个自动化系统，可以根据用户的查询分析在线文章，并生成适合用户信息需求的连贯数据故事。通过两个模块涵盖通过两个模块解决非结构化文本讲故事的主要挑战：在线文章检索，收集相关文章；数据事实提取，识别、验证和提炼定量事实；事实组织，将相关事实聚类并合并为连贯的主题组；视觉讲故事，通过交互式滚动讲述界面中的可视化，将有组织的事实转化为叙述。我们通过定量分析评估了 Compendia，确认事实提取和组织的准确性，并通过对 16 名参与者进行的两项用户研究，展示了其可用性、有效性以及为开放式查询生成引人入胜的视觉故事的能力。

data.title: DreamBarbie: Text to Barbie-Style 3D Avatars
data.author: Xiaokun Sun, Zhenyu Zhang, Ying Tai, Hao Tang, Zili Yi, Jian Yang
data.summary: To integrate digital humans into everyday life, there is a strong demand for generating high-quality, fine-grained disentangled 3D avatars that support expressive animation and simulation capabilities, ideally from low-cost textual inputs. Although text-driven 3D avatar generation has made significant progress by leveraging 2D generative priors, existing methods still struggle to fulfill all these requirements simultaneously. To address this challenge, we propose DreamBarbie, a novel text-driven framework for generating animatable 3D avatars with separable shoes, accessories, and simulation-ready garments, truly capturing the iconic “Barbie doll” aesthetic. The core of our framework lies in an expressive 3D representation combined with appropriate modeling constraints. Unlike prior methods, we use G-Shell to uniformly model watertight components (e.g., bodies, shoes) and non-watertight garments. By reformulating boundaries as Euclidean field intersections instead of manifold geodesics, we propose an SDF-based initialization and a hole regularization loss that together achieve a $100\times$ speedup and stable open topology without image input. These disentangled 3D representations are then optimized by specialized expert diffusion models tailored to each domain, ensuring high-fidelity outputs. To mitigate geometric artifacts and texture conflicts when combining different expert models, we further propose several effective geometric losses and strategies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DreamBarbie outperforms existing methods in both dressed human and outfit generation. Our framework further enables diverse applications, including apparel combination, editing, expressive animation, and physical simulation.
data.title_cn: DreamBarbie：文本到芭比风格的 3D 头像
data.abstract_cn: 为了将数字人类融入日常生活，强烈需要生成高质量、细粒度的解开的 3D 化身，这些化身支持富有表现力的动画和模拟功能，最好是通过低成本的文本输入。尽管文本驱动的 3D 头像生成通过利用 2D 生成先验取得了重大进展，但现有方法仍然难以同时满足所有这些要求。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 DreamBarbie，这是一种新颖的文本驱动框架，用于生成带有可分离鞋子、配饰和模拟服装的可动画 3D 头像，真正捕捉标志性的“芭比娃娃”美学。我们框架的核心在于富有表现力的 3D 表示与适当的建模约束相结合。与之前的方法不同，我们使用 G-Shell 对防水组件（例如身体、鞋子）和非防水服装进行统一建模。通过将边界重新表示为欧几里德场交集而不是流形测地线，我们提出了基于 SDF 的初始化和孔正则化损失，它们共同实现了 100 倍的加速和稳定的开放拓扑，无需图像输入。然后，通过针对每个领域量身定制的专业扩散模型来优化这些解开的 3D 表示，确保高保真输出。为了减轻组合不同专家模型时的几何伪影和纹理冲突，我们进一步提出了几种有效的几何损失和策略。大量实验表明，DreamBarbie 在穿着人类和服装生成方面均优于现有方法。我们的框架进一步支持多样化的应用，包括服装组合、编辑、表现力动画和物理模拟。

data.title: Robust Image Stitching with Optimal Plane
data.author: Lang Nie, Yuan Mei, Kang Liao, Xunqiu Xu, Chunyu Lin, Bin Xiao
data.summary: We present \textit{RopStitch}, an unsupervised deep image stitching framework with both robustness and naturalness. To ensure the robustness of \textit{RopStitch}, we propose to incorporate the universal prior of content perception into the image stitching model by a dual-branch architecture. It separately captures coarse and fine features and integrates them to achieve highly generalizable performance across diverse unseen real-world scenes. Concretely, the dual-branch model consists of a pretrained branch to capture semantically invariant representations and a learnable branch to extract fine-grained discriminative features, which are then merged into a whole by a controllable factor at the correlation level. Besides, considering that content alignment and structural preservation are often contradictory to each other, we propose a concept of virtual optimal planes to relieve this conflict. To this end, we model this problem as a process of estimating homography decomposition coefficients, and design an iterative coefficient predictor and minimal semantic distortion constraint to identify the optimal plane. This scheme is finally incorporated into \textit{RopStitch} by warping both views onto the optimal plane bidirectionally. Extensive experiments across various datasets demonstrate that \textit{RopStitch} significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly in scene robustness and content naturalness. The code is available at {\color{red}https://github.com/MmelodYy/RopStitch}.
data.title_cn: 具有最佳平面的稳健图像拼接
data.abstract_cn: 我们提出了 \textit{RopStitch}，一种兼具鲁棒性和自然性的无监督深度图像拼接框架。为了确保 \textit{RopStitch} 的鲁棒性，我们建议通过双分支架构将内容感知的通用先验合并到图像拼接模型中。它分别捕获粗略和精细的特征，并将它们集成起来，以在各种未见过的现实世界场景中实现高度通用的性能。具体来说，双分支模型由一个用于捕获语义不变表示的预训练分支和一个用于提取细粒度判别特征的可学习分支组成，然后通过相关级别的可控因素将其合并为一个整体。此外，考虑到内容对齐和结构保留往往是相互矛盾的，我们提出了虚拟最优平面的概念来缓解这种冲突。为此，我们将此问题建模为估计单应性分解系数的过程，并设计迭代系数预测器和最小语义失真约束来识别最佳平面。该方案最终通过将两个视图双向扭曲到最佳平面上并入 \textit{RopStitch} 中。跨各种数据集的大量实验表明， \textit{RopStitch} 显着优于现有方法，特别是在场景鲁棒性和内容自然度方面。代码可在 {\color{red}https://github.com/MmelodYy/RopStitch} 获取。

data.title: FreNTS: Neural Texture Synthesis in Frequency Domain
data.author: Dongdong Yue, Xinyi Liu, Yongjun Zhang, Jinming Zhang, Yong Luo, Zeshuang Zheng, Yi Wan
data.summary: Although existing texture synthesis methods perform well in generating large images with irregularly repeated textures to avoid visually unrealistic repetitions, they still face significant challenges in synthesizing regular textures with densely interconnected structures. In this paper, we propose a novel neural texture synthesis method, FreNTS, which uses frequency domain information to enhance the texture synthesis process, synthesizing textures with continuous, complete, and visually realistic overall structures. The core idea is to perform the Discrete Cosine Transform on image patches to obtain the corresponding frequency domain rate information features, and then use the designed adaptive guided correspondence (AGC) loss to calculate the correlation difference between the source image and the target image in the frequency domain and spatial domains, thereby constraining the optimization of the target image to achieve high-quality texture synthesis. In addition, to better evaluate the effect of texture synthesis, we introduce Tile LPIPS as the metric for quantitative evaluation. Experimental results show that the proposed FreNTS can effectively accelerate the process of neural texture synthesis and use high-frequency information to capture better structural details to synthesize realistic textures.
data.title_cn: FreNTS：频域神经纹理合成
data.abstract_cn: 尽管现有的纹理合成方法在生成具有不规则重复纹理的大图像以避免视觉上不切实际的重复方面表现良好，但它们在合成具有密集互连结构的规则纹理方面仍然面临着重大挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的神经纹理合成方法FreNTS，该方法利用频域信息来增强纹理合成过程，合成具有连续、完整且视觉逼真的整体结构的纹理。其核心思想是对图像块进行离散余弦变换，得到相应的频域速率信息特征，然后利用设计的自适应引导对应（AGC）损失计算源图像与目标图像在频域和空间域的相关性差异，从而约束目标图像的优化，实现高质量的纹理合成。此外，为了更好地评估纹理合成的效果，我们引入了Tile LPIPS作为定量评估的指标。实验结果表明，所提出的FreNTS可以有效加速神经纹理合成的过程，并利用高频信息捕获更好的结构细节来合成逼真的纹理。

data.title: Deep LoRA-Unfolding Networks for Image Restoration
data.author: Xiangming Wang, Haijin Zeng, Benteng Sun, Jiezhang Cao, Kai Zhang, Qiangqiang Shen, Yongyong Chen
data.summary: Deep unfolding networks (DUNs), combining conventional iterative optimization algorithms and deep neural networks into a multi-stage framework, have achieved remarkable accomplishments in Image Restoration (IR), such as spectral imaging reconstruction, compressive sensing and super-resolution. It unfolds the iterative optimization steps into a stack of sequentially linked blocks.
